Coverage spans 400+ cities with thousands of reusable data layers and CAD/GeoJSON (DXF) exports. Backed by 500 Global. Programmatic API access is offered on the enterprise Business tier.

providers.name: HiGuest
providers.description: HiGuests (Hi Guests Vacation Homes Rental LLC, License 765614) is a Dubai-based short-term rental property management company. It offers full-service management for vacation homes and furnished apartments, listing owners' properties across 20+ booking channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, and others), and handling profile creation, dynamic pricing, booking and guest communications, 24/7 guest support, check-in/check-out, housekeeping, and maintenance, alongside transparent owner reporting. HiGuests markets a zero-commission subscription plan for landlords and operates a guest-facing booking site. It is a hospitality services business, not an API/developer platform; no public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jome
providers.description: Jome is a real estate technology marketplace for buying new construction homes, describing itself as the most joyful way to buy a new home in the age of AI. Buyers can search and compare thousands of new-construction homes and communities from multiple builders, view pricing and builder incentives, instantly book and confirm home tours, and receive AI-powered personalized recommendations, with new-home experts guiding them from contract to closing. Jome operates as a licensed real estate brokerage across 18+ U.S. metros, primarily in Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Arizona, Georgia, Colorado, South Carolina, and Tennessee, and runs dedicated portals for builders and agents. Backed by Techstars. Jome publishes no public API or developer program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence.

providers.name: NoBroker
providers.description: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt Ltd is an Indian proptech company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bengaluru, that operates a brokerage-free real estate marketplace connecting property owners directly with tenants and buyers across Indian metros. Beyond listings for flats, houses, villas, plots, PGs and commercial space, NoBroker sells adjacent home services — rental and lease agreement drafting, legal assistance, packers and movers, painting and cleaning, home loans and rent payments — and operates NoBrokerHood, a gated-community and housing-society management / ERP product covering visitor management, billing, accounting and complaints. NoBroker became India's first proptech unicorn in 2021. The company ships software only as an end-user web and mobile product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its application endpoints under /api/v1..v5 are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Zuma
providers.description: Zuma (legally Resident Boost Inc., d/b/a Zuma) is an AI platform for the multifamily / apartment industry, best known for "Kelsey," an AI assistant with human back-up that handles renter engagement across the resident lifecycle. Kelsey automates leasing (responding to inquiries, qualifying prospects, and scheduling tours), rent collections (payment reminders, late-resident follow-up, and commitment tracking), move-outs (notices, inspections, and security-deposit handling), and inbound property calls via VoiceAI. Zuma integrates into property-management and CRM systems used by operators — Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, Knock, and Microsoft/Google calendars — to boost NOI and conversion. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Zuma does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public web, commercial, and operational surface.

providers.name: CentralComs
providers.description: CentralComs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) proptech company building AI agents that automate maintenance coordination and leasing for residential and small-commercial property managers. Its agents field tenant, prospect, and owner messages 24/7, triage and dispatch maintenance work orders to ranked vendors, follow up until tickets close with verification photos, and answer lease/listing/HOA questions with the exact clause cited. A leasing agent captures multi-channel leads, scores qualification, matches units, analyzes documents, and runs background screening. CentralComs bills flat monthly per door with no per-message fees and keeps records aligned with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, and DoorLoop via CSV today, with native two-way PMS integrations on the roadmap. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; the company does not yet publish a public API — it is an AI agent product with PMS integrations planned rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: RentSpree
providers.description: RentSpree is a Los Angeles-headquartered rental real estate technology platform that streamlines the long-tail rental transaction for real estate agents, landlords, property managers, and renters. Its consumer-facing product suite covers online rental applications, TransUnion-powered tenant screening (credit, background, eviction, and income verification), e-sign and lease workflows, ACH/card rent payments, AI-assisted listing pages and syndication, rent estimate, and renters insurance. RentSpree positions itself as the rental layer for the MLS and brokerage ecosystem and has built named integrations with Multiple Listing Services (Bright MLS, CRMLS, Beaches MLS, CJMLS, Florida Realtors) and PropTech partners (SkySlope, Lone Wolf, ZipLogix, C.A.R. OnlineEd). It also runs an Enterprise API Integration program for MLSs, associations, brokerages, and PropTech vendors that want to embed rental application intake and tenant screening into their own platforms — documentation is not publicly published; partners are onboarded through a sales/integration process with implementation quoted at as little as three weeks. There is no self-serve developer portal, no public OpenAPI specification, and no public SDK or CLI; the RentSpree GitHub org is effectively empty (only a .github org-defaults repo). RentSpree is SOC 2 Type II certified and reports more than four million agents, landlords, and renters on the platform.

providers.name: Closinglock
providers.description: Closinglock is an Austin, Texas fintech and fraud-prevention company whose platform secures the money movement and identity checks inside a residential real estate closing. Title companies, real estate attorneys, agents, underwriters and their buyers and sellers use it to share wire instructions over an authenticated channel instead of email, verify identity and bank-account ownership before funds move, collect and disburse funds through SecurePay digital payments, retrieve and verify mortgage payoff statements, manage and e-sign closing documents, run two-way text messaging with the parties to a file, and evidence FinCEN and ALTA Best Practices obligations. The company announced SOC 2 Type II certification in August 2023 and raised a $34M Series B led by Sageview Capital in January 2025. Closinglock ships integrations into the major title production systems — SoftPro, RamQuest and ResWare — plus a DocuSign e-signature partnership, but those integrations are built bilaterally with each vendor: as of this profile Closinglock publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: First American Financial
providers.description: First American Financial is a leading provider of title insurance, settlement services, and risk solutions for real estate transactions, as well as related products and services. First American operates a developer portal exposing APIs for office lookup, order management, document exchange, messaging, and webhook notifications.

providers.name: Loft
providers.description: Loft is a Brazilian real estate technology (proptech) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sao Paulo. It operates a marketplace for buying, selling, and renting residential property alongside a broad platform of software and financial services for the real estate sector, including a CRM and property-management tools for agencies, digital proposals and e-signatures, lead generation, rental administration, and fintech products such as rental guarantees (Fianca Aluguel), home financing, credit with property collateral, and residential and commercial insurance. Backed by a16z, QED Investors, Fifth Wall, D1 Capital, Thrive Capital, and Baillie Gifford, Loft is a market leader in Brazil's real estate fintech space. Loft does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization (loft-br) hosts internal engineering and data-science tooling.

providers.name: PlotAPI
providers.description: Automotive and property data API. The published surface covers US VIN histories and vehicle specifications, UK MOT records, auto parts fitment catalogues, vehicle valuations, and property listings for the UK and US markets, served as typed JSON over a single REST endpoint. Positioned for AI agents and for developers who would otherwise integrate several gated data sources separately. The product is real and live; what is not public is the interface — documentation, the API reference and key issuance all sit behind an account sign-in, and the machine-readable artifacts the site advertises are not currently served.

providers.name: appearhere
providers.description: Appear Here is the leading online marketplace for short-term retail space, connecting property owners with brands, designers, and entrepreneurs who want to rent shops, pop-up stores, market stalls, showrooms, and event venues on a flexible, short-term basis. Founded in London in 2014 and backed by Balderton Capital, the two-sided marketplace lets tenants search available space by city and date, book securely online with standardized legal agreements, and message landlords directly, while landlords list and monetize idle retail units. Appear Here operates across the UK, US, and France and has facilitated the opening of more than 10,000 stores for over 250,000 brands and creative entrepreneurs. Appear Here does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Entera
providers.description: Entera is an AI-powered SaaS and services platform for single-family rental (SFR) real estate investing, describing itself as the operating system for single-family real estate. It helps operators, funds, new-construction companies, agents, and service partners buy, sell, and operate homes at scale across 34+ U.S. residential markets. The platform spans acquisitions (asset discovery, underwriting, diligence coordination), dispositions (pricing, buyer targeting, offer management), transaction enablement, market data and intelligence, and expert brokerage services. Entera is backed by investors including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Entera exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI/SDK surface; this profile captures its published company, legal, and brand properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Praxis
providers.description: Praxis is a New York-based company building an internet-native community and city-development venture — "an online community starting a new city" — founded in 2019 by Dryden Brown and Charlie Callinan. It operates a membership community at praxisnation.com whose stated purpose is to create a new culture and a resident-owned physical city, and a members-only account portal at portal.praxisnation.com where members view their PRAX holdings and manage their account. In October 2024 Praxis announced $525M in financing toward development of its first city. Praxis is a real-estate, community and smart-cities company, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: RenoFi
providers.description: RenoFi is a home-renovation financing platform that partners with credit unions and lenders to offer renovation-specific loans underwritten against a home's projected after-renovation value (ARV) rather than its current equity, letting homeowners borrow significantly more without refinancing their first mortgage. RenoFi is not itself a lender: it originates and prepares applications, performs renovation underwriting, and connects homeowners, contractors, realtors, and credit-union partners to its lending network for RenoFi Home Equity Loans and HELOCs. The company maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Ruby infrastructure libraries (GraphQL and Salesforce tooling) but publishes no public product API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited
providers.description: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited operates Smart Bricks, an AI-powered real estate investment platform that uses proprietary foundational models and autonomous agents to help retail and institutional investors discover, underwrite, execute, and monitor property deals globally. Backed by a16z, Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Techstars, and 500 Global, the company automates deal sourcing, risk modeling across 1,000+ variables per opportunity, diligence, documentation, and portfolio intelligence. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; Smart Bricks currently publishes a consumer and institutional web application but no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Splitero
providers.description: Splitero is a San Diego, California fintech founded in 2021 by Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler that originates Home Equity Investments (HEIs) — a lump sum of cash, up to $500,000, paid to a homeowner today in exchange for a share of the home's future value, with no monthly payments, no income requirement, credit scores accepted from 500, and terms of up to 30 years. The company operates a consumer application and servicing portal at my.splitero.com, funds its originations through institutional capital commitments (including a $350M facility led by Blue Owl Capital), and has expanded into a licensed residential brokerage, Splitero Homes. Splitero is an end-user consumer finance product: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Squares
providers.description: Squares is a marketplace platform for discovering and booking curated, personally-vetted workspaces around the world — lofts, photo studios, rooftops, and villas suited to remote workers, creatives, and digital nomads. Spaces are scouted across 13+ cities including Almaty, Da Nang, and Austin, and hosts can list their own spaces on the platform. Squares is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer marketplace website but no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: swivl
providers.description: swivl is an AI automation platform built specifically for the self-storage industry. It combines a unified CRM and contact center that consolidates calls, texts, emails, and chats with AI agents for sales, billing, support, and review management, plus a tenant mobile app (Spot) for access codes, payments, and referrals. Its self-storage natural-language model is trained on hundreds of thousands of customer conversations and serves 3,500+ locations. Founded in New York City and backed by Techstars, swivl advertises open APIs and integrations with major self-storage management systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Tailorbird
providers.description: Tailorbird is a CapEx orchestration platform for the multifamily real estate industry, replacing spreadsheet-based capital planning with AI-generated property intelligence. The platform produces unit-level as-builts, takeoffs, and interior models, runs renovation ROI and five-year capital plans, and tracks spend and budget variance in real time across apartment portfolios. Tailorbird ingests PCAs and property documents, integrates with major property-management ERPs including Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, and MRI via custom APIs and ELTs, and maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance. Founded in 2020 and based in Princeton, New Jersey, it serves 28 of the NMHC Top 50 operators and manages more than $2B in annual CapEx across over one million mapped units. It is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company.

providers.name: Tenex
providers.description: Tenex is a PropTech platform for real estate and hospitality operators across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, offering an all-in-one suite that unifies property management, tenant and landlord experience, facility and asset management, real estate accounting, VR for off-plan developments, and a hospitality guest experience app. Trusted across 500+ buildings and communities, it advertises integrations with ZATCA, SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics to automate compliance and unify operations. Tenex is backed by 500 Global and the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is published.

providers.name: MHub
providers.description: MHub is a Malaysian property-technology (proptech) platform operated by TRB Ventures Sdn Bhd and backed by 500 Global. It gives real-estate developers an integrated system to manage the entire new-property sales cycle — from lead generation, launch, and online booking (Showroom, CRM, SalesCandy) through automated billing and collections (Credit Control), accounting and financial reporting, statutory compliance (HIMS/KPKT registry synchronization and LHDN-compliant e-invoicing), commission control, and handover/defect management. MHub runs a developer portal at developer.mhub.my and an authentication-gated REST API at api.mhub.my for platform integrations.

providers.name: Baselane
providers.description: Baselane is an all-in-one financial platform (financial operating system) for independent landlords and real estate investors, combining FDIC-insured landlord banking, automated rent collection, bookkeeping and expense tracking, analytics and reporting, and cash-flow tools in a single product. Banking services are provided through partner Thread Bank, and account connectivity to external banks is powered by Plaid. Baselane is a consumer/SMB fintech application (web and mobile apps) rather than an API platform: it publishes no first-party public developer API, developer portal, or API reference. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sector: fintech / proptech.

providers.name: Homebound
providers.description: Homebound is a tech-enabled, personalized homebuilder that pairs a proprietary software platform with a managed network of trade partners to build homes on a customer's lot, sell finished and in-progress inventory homes, and run disaster rebuild programs — most notably wildfire recovery in California. Homeowners track budget, schedule, documents, and construction progress through a Homeowner Portal. Backed by Fifth Wall, Forerunner Ventures, and GV, Homebound operates in the construction-tech sector. Homebound does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its public engineering footprint is the homebound-team GitHub organization and the first-party open-source packages it publishes to the @homebound npm scope (the Beam design system, form-state, and truss). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched from public company surfaces.

providers.name: Housable
providers.description: Housable is a California-focused proptech company that helps rental-property owners and operators develop Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) as a portfolio value-add strategy. Its platform manages ADU projects end to end — from concept and financial feasibility analysis through design, permitting, bidding, construction, and lease-up — and lets operators run many parallel developments across their properties at once, converting underused spaces such as leasing offices, garages, and parking areas into new rental units alongside ground-up ADU construction. Housable is an early-stage startup backed by Kindred Ventures and other seed investors. It is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Sankun
providers.description: Sankun (산군) is a South Korean construction-industry big data platform based in Seoul that aggregates and sells access to eight integrated construction databases covering roughly 280,000 construction companies, some 820,000 project sites, government e-procurement bids, contract awards, professional reputation reviews, and construction news. Alongside its web application and a construction sales CRM (Sankun Sales), the company markets a Sankun API (data.sankun.com) for programmatic access to its construction data, though public developer documentation is gated behind sales and login. Sankun is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: AvantStay
providers.description: AvantStay is a technology-enabled luxury vacation rental management and hospitality company operating professionally designed short-term rental homes built for group travel across premium destinations throughout the United States. Beyond curated beachfront villas, desert estates, and mountain cabins, AvantStay runs a full-service homeowner property-management program through its Lighthouse owner portal, a 24-hour guest concierge, and a real-estate brokerage for buyers acquiring investment vacation homes. It is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass AvantStay publishes a consumer booking website and homeowner portal but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Booqed
providers.description: BOOQED is a Hong Kong-based proptech company building flexible workplace technology that turns underutilized real estate into bookable, on-demand workspace. Its flagship product QUBIC is a line of sound-isolating, modular smart booths and work pods (for one to six people) with soundproofing, ventilation, power, and a proprietary access-control system managed through a mobile web app. Alongside the hardware, BOOQED offers space-management SaaS that makes existing meeting rooms and desks bookable and trackable with utilization analytics, plus the BOOQED app for individuals to book hot desks and meeting rooms on demand across Hong Kong, Singapore, and Shenzhen. Founded by David Wong, Charles Oh, and Ken Huang, BOOQED went through the Colliers and Techstars proptech accelerator and raised seed funding in 2019. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; BOOQED does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: DiversyFund
providers.description: DiversyFund is a San Diego based private-markets investment platform that packages institutional-style fixed income and multifamily real estate offerings for individual accredited investors. Formed in 2016 and qualified under SEC Regulation A+, the firm acts as sponsor, developer and manager of its own funds rather than as a broker, and reports having acquired more than $300 million across 20+ multifamily properties for a base of 28,000+ investors. Its current offering, the Distressed Income Fund, is a Reg D 506(c) preferred-equity vehicle sold to accredited investors with a target allocation of $100K to $1M. Investing is transacted through a private, authenticated investor portal at portal.diversyfund.com (WorkOS AuthKit); DiversyFund publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: flatfair
providers.description: flatfair is a UK-based tenancy deposit platform for letting agents, landlords, and Build-to-Rent operators, offering deposit alternatives and deposit administration products. Its products include No Deposit (tenants pay 28% of one month's rent plus VAT instead of a five-week cash deposit), Deposits, Unlock Deposits, Deposit Boost, tenant Referencing, and Tenant Guarantor. flatfair is used by more than 850 agents and Build-to-Rent operators to reduce move-in friction and cut deposit administration time by around 60 minutes per tenancy. The company operates a web application for agents and tenants but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Houst
providers.description: Houst is a global short-term rental and Airbnb management company founded in 2015, operating in 17 cities across 8 countries and managing over 11,650 properties. Houst handles the full hosting lifecycle for homeowners and landlords - multi-platform listing creation and optimization, dynamic pricing, professional photography, 24/7 guest communication and vetting, check-in coordination, cleaning, linen and maintenance - powered by a proprietary host dashboard that tracks earnings, occupancy, bookings and performance. The company operates on a commission model and also runs an operating-partner and affiliate programme. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: London House Exchange (Property Partner)
providers.description: London House Exchange, formerly Property Partner, is an FCA-regulated online platform that operates the world's only regulated exchange for individual residential, student and commercial properties. Founded in 2014 and now owned by US digital homeownership company Better, the platform lets retail investors buy fractional shares in professionally managed UK properties, earn monthly dividends from rental income, and trade those shares with other investors on a secondary market. It also offers property-backed mortgage bonds, an ISA, and bridging finance, with over £100m of fractionalised property assets under management and thousands of investors across more than 80 countries. It was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Lower
providers.description: Lower is a U.S. direct-to-consumer mortgage lender and servicer (Lower, LLC, NMLS #1124061) offering home purchase loans, refinancing, and home equity products including conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, and adjustable-rate mortgages, HELOCs, and cash-out options. Lower operates a mobile-first application experience with dedicated loan officers and conducts business in 47 states plus the District of Columbia. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. Lower publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web, legal, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: PadSplit
providers.description: PadSplit is an Atlanta-based co-living marketplace that makes affordable housing accessible by connecting members seeking private rooms in shared homes with property owners who host them. The platform offers flexible weekly payments, fast move-ins, all-inclusive rent (utilities, wifi, and furnishings), member background screening, and a rewards program that helps residents build credit. PadSplit operates across multiple U.S. metros as a two-sided marketplace serving both members (renters) and hosts (property owners), and was backed by Techstars. The company has no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Qbiq
providers.description: Qbiq is an AI-powered space planning and architectural visualization platform for real estate. It lets brokers, architects, developers, and space planners generate optimized 2D floor plans, photorealistic 3D renderings, virtual tours, Revit/CAD models, and quantity takeoffs from an uploaded space plan (CAD, PDF, or JPEG) in minutes. Qbiq automates test-fits and layout optimization for offices and commercial real estate, comparing multiple design options against program requirements. The company is backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Qbiq operates a hosted web application (plan.qbiq.ai) and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Quinto Andar
providers.description: QuintoAndar is a Brazilian proptech real-estate marketplace that lets people rent and buy homes online without a guarantor, with digital visit scheduling, digital contract signing, rent and sale pricing intelligence (QPreço), owner financial management, and a real-estate consortium financing program. It operates a two-sided marketplace across major Brazilian cities including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre, Campinas, and Curitiba, earning revenue on rental and sales commissions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ribbit-capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found; the company does publish a security.txt with a Bugcrowd bug bounty program.

providers.name: Basebuild
providers.description: Basebuild Labs, Inc. builds Beams, an AI project manager for construction and real estate teams. The product automatically transcribes project meetings, tracks decisions and action items, and assembles a searchable knowledge base from those discussions, capturing information without requiring a bot to join the call. It is aimed at giving construction and real estate project teams real-time visibility and control over teams, projects, budgets, and finances. Basebuild is an early-stage Canaan Partners portfolio company based in Santa Monica, California, and this API Evangelist profile tracks its public-facing surface. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and a product login only, with no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documentation surface to catalog.

providers.name: Flock Homes
providers.description: Flock Homes is a real estate investment platform, founded in 2020 and backed by a16z, that lets individual rental-property owners retire from active landlording by contributing their single-family and multifamily homes into a professionally managed, diversified residential real estate fund. Flock uses a 721 Exchange (an UPREIT contribution) so owners can trade appreciated rental property for fund shares on a tax-deferred basis, deferring capital gains and depreciation-recapture taxes while eliminating repair, vacancy, and eviction responsibilities. Fund investors receive quarterly cash-flow distributions and long-term appreciation across a nationwide portfolio, with Flock handling all property management, maintenance, and tenant operations. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BeyondHQ
providers.description: BeyondHQ is a distributed workforce planning platform that combines talent, cost, and location data to enable cross-functional decision making for hybrid and distributed teams. It equips HR, Real Estate, and Finance teams with a single, integrated experience that centralizes hiring and location-planning processes, providing real-time interactive comparisons across 500+ markets, 70,000+ searchable job skills, 750+ searchable occupations, and 50,000+ market-data combinations. The platform helps companies determine where to hire and physically locate their workforce using trusted, real-time data. BeyondHQ is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. BeyondHQ does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Douglas Elliman
providers.description: Douglas Elliman Inc. (NYSE: DOUG) is a residential real estate brokerage founded in 1911 and headquartered at 575 Madison Avenue, New York City. It is one of the largest brokerages in the New York metropolitan area and among the largest in the United States, with roughly 6,000 agents across New York, Florida, California, Texas, Colorado, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Nevada, New Jersey, Vermont, the Mid-Atlantic, and international outposts in France and Monaco. Its home market is the United States. In the value chain Douglas Elliman sits on the SELL side as a licensed brokerage and MLS participant — it consumes MLS listing data under IDX and broker agreements rather than originating a syndicated feed — and it extends into development marketing, property management, commercial brokerage, title and escrow (Douglas Elliman Title), relocation, and PropTech venture investment through New Valley Ventures. Its API posture is honest and thin: no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published access path of any kind. developer.elliman.com, developers.elliman.com, and docs.elliman.com all resolve to the marketing homepage via a wildcard catch-all rather than to a portal, and api.elliman.com exists as an IIS/ASP.NET host that returns HTTP 403 at its root with no documentation behind it. On RESO, Douglas Elliman Real Estate is listed as a Class D member (Brokers, Agents and Appraisers) on the RESO membership roster but does NOT appear in the RESO certified-organizations directory — it is a RESO member, not a RESO-certified data provider, and it publishes no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData endpoint, and no UPI surface. The single public engineering artifact the company ships is a GitHub fork of a third-party .NET RETS client library, which is consumer-side evidence that Elliman pulls MLS data in rather than producer-side evidence that it exposes any.

providers.name: Duranta
providers.description: Duranta Labs is an applied AI laboratory building geospatial and computer-vision technology to understand the physical world. Its foundation vision model, Aidan, generates accurate, current 4D digital twins from optical imagery. That model powers a Landscapers solution that lets professionals measure, design, and bid any property directly from imagery without a site visit, a general-purpose World Model for spatial intelligence, and a forthcoming AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) product that turns an address into a precise digital model. Duranta is backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: OJO Labs
providers.description: OJO Labs is an Austin, Texas real estate technology company founded in 2015 that operates Movoto, one of the largest consumer real estate search portals in the United States, alongside OJO's homeownership platform for buyers, sellers and existing homeowners. The company pairs AI-driven property search and home-value tracking with human real estate advisors, and monetizes primarily through an agent referral network that routes qualified consumers to licensed brokerages. OJO acquired Movoto in 2020 and The LEAD Syndicate in 2024, launching Lever by Movoto as its industry-facing agent platform, and was itself acquired by Columbus, Ohio mortgage lender Lower in May 2025. OJO Labs is an end-user product company: it publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and its lead delivery to agent CRMs is handled through email parsing and third-party middleware rather than a documented partner API.

providers.name: Ray White
providers.description: Ray White is Australasia's largest real estate group, a family-owned brokerage network founded in 1902 and headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, running 550+ Australian offices and roughly a thousand offices in total across Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, Papua New Guinea, the Middle East and Atlanta USA, spanning residential sales, auctions, commercial (Ray White Commercial / rwc.com.au), rural and livestock, property management, projects, marine, hotels, valuations, business sales, insurance and mortgage broking through sister brand Loan Market. In the Australian property value chain Ray White sits on the AGENCY side of a portal duopoly — it lists into REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain rather than operating a portal or a registry of its own — and it is an API CONSUMER, not an API producer. In December 2025 Ray White named realestate.com.au and PropTrack its data partners explicitly for their "industry leading API architecture", piping that licensed market data into its proprietary OneSystem, NurtureCloud and Pulse platforms. Its API posture is therefore honestly stated as none-published — as of 2026-07-26 no developer portal, no public API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published partner-API application path could be found on raywhite.com or any developer/api/docs subdomain (all of which fail DNS resolution). RESO is absent — Ray White does not appear in the RESO certification directory, which is unsurprising because RESO is a North American, NAR-driven mandate with no Australian counterpart; Australia's closest thing to a required machine-readable property rail is PEXA electronic conveyancing, which Ray White transacts through as a participant rather than exposes.

providers.name: Stuf Storage
providers.description: Stuf is a next-generation, tech-enabled self-storage operator that partners with commercial real estate owners to convert underutilized space — basements, garages and retail vacancies — into modern neighborhood storage facilities. Stuf runs 36 facilities across seven US metros (New York City, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Atlanta, Boston and Washington, DC). Members search and book units online, pay month-to-month with all-inclusive pricing and no hidden fees, and open facility doors with a digital key issued through the Stuf Member Dashboard. Stuf publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract; the one machine-readable surface it does serve is a substantial, actively maintained llms.txt at https://www.stufstorage.com/llms.txt, alongside an AI-crawler-permissive robots.txt.

providers.name: Up&Up
providers.description: Up&Up (legal name Homevest Inc.) is a New York-based rental housing platform that lets renters build wealth while they rent. Instead of a traditional security deposit, renters contribute to an Up&Up Wallet that grows through their own contributions, a share of monthly rental profits, and appreciation in the home's value; at lease end they can buy the home, transfer the wallet to another Up&Up rental, renew, or cash out. Founded by Michael Wong, Ryan Brown, and Ben Wong, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Up&Up operates a consumer web application and a private backend at api.upandup.co, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Avenue One
providers.description: Avenue One is a New York-based technology service platform and investment marketplace for institutional owners, buyers, sellers, lenders and borrowers of residential rental real estate. Founded in 2020, it connects institutional debt and equity capital to local operating partners and property owners across 21+ U.S. markets, combining proprietary property data, automated valuation, and a vetted partner network to find, finance, buy, renovate, lease, manage and sell single-family rental homes at scale. Its service lines span lending (bridge and SFR portfolio loans), strategy development, acquisitions, renovations, asset management, title and brokerage or dispositions. The company reports $2.2B+ of capital deployed. Its software runs as a private, login-gated product suite ("AvenueOS") for internal, builder, investor and partner users; no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: Second Home
providers.description: Second Home is a flexible workspace and cultural venue provider committed to supporting entrepreneurship, innovation, and community, with locations in London (Spitalfields and Holland Park) and Lisbon (Mercado da Ribeira). It offers coworking (resident and roaming desks), private offices, day passes, meeting-room and venue hire, and a program of cultural events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a consumer/business workspace brand rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Tellus
providers.description: Tellus is a consumer fintech company whose mobile app pairs high-yield savings tools with real-estate-backed lending and property management. Members earn competitive rates on cash held in Tellus accounts, funded by the company's portfolio of residential real-estate loans, with deposits held at FDIC-insured partner banks. The app also offers a mobile wallet, a business wallet, and property-management tooling for landlords and property owners. Tellus is a private, venture-backed startup (an a16z portfolio company); it operates as a direct-to-consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: FlyHomes
providers.description: Flyhomes is a Bellevue, Washington-based real estate and mortgage financial technology company whose Buy Before You Sell platform lets homebuyers purchase a new home before selling their existing one. Its products—Flyhomes Cash Offer, Instant Equity, and Guaranteed Backup Contract—turn financing into competitive cash-like offers, unlock home equity without requiring a prior sale, and reduce a buyer's debt-to-income ratio so they can qualify for larger loans and move only once. Flyhomes reaches homebuyers through a network of in-network loan officers and real estate agents and also operates an AI-powered home search portal. Flyhomes does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, discovery surface (llms.txt), and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Kasa Living
providers.description: Kasa Living, Inc. (operating as Kasa) is a San Francisco-founded, tech-enabled hospitality company that partners with institutional real-estate owners to convert multifamily, single-family and hotel inventory into professionally managed, apartment-style flexible accommodations across 90+ U.S. cities. Founded in 2016 by Roman Pedan, Kasa runs a proprietary hospitality operating system covering dynamic pricing, automated operations, keyless self check-in and a 24/7 remote "Virtual Front Desk" instead of an on-site front desk, and distributes inventory direct at kasa.com plus through OTAs and GDS via the NextPax supply API. Kasa publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable API specification; its one machine-readable, agent-facing artifact is a hand-authored llms.txt served at kasa.com/llms.txt.

providers.name: SkenarioLabs
providers.description: SkenarioLabs is a Helsinki-based real estate finance data intelligence company (founded 2015) that turns fragmented building data into auditable, asset-level intelligence for European banks and financial institutions. From a single address it reconstructs complete building profiles covering automated valuation, climate and transition risk, energy performance, technical condition, and renovation potential — aligned with CRREM, EU Taxonomy, ECB, EBA, CRR3, MEPS, and SFDR frameworks. It serves 200+ institutional clients monitoring over 60 billion euros of collateral and scores more than one million assets monthly. SkenarioLabs delivers its intelligence ad hoc into loan origination, portfolio audit, and continuous risk-monitoring workflows rather than through a public self-serve developer API.

providers.name: Snapdocs
providers.description: Snapdocs is a digital mortgage closing platform that connects lenders, title and settlement companies, notaries, and signing services on a single system to automate the loan closing process. The platform provides eClosing and hybrid closing workflows, Notary Connect for scheduling and coordinating signing agents, automated document quality control, and an eVault for secure eNote registration and management. Snapdocs is used across roughly one in four U.S. residential mortgage transactions and connects to the major loan origination, point-of-sale, title production, and RON systems through pre-built partner integrations rather than a public self-serve developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SV Angel and Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Bowery Valuation
providers.description: Bowery Valuation is a New York-headquartered, technology-enabled commercial real estate appraisal firm that pairs state-certified appraisers with a proprietary cloud platform for comparable-sales research, rent-roll and income analysis, mobile property inspection capture, adjustment grids, narrative report components and XML report generation. The firm appraises multifamily, mixed-use, office, retail, industrial, self-storage, condo/co-op, affordable housing, land and ground-up construction assets across all 50 U.S. states for banks, agency (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) lenders, funds and private lenders. The appraisal platform is used internally by Bowery's own appraisers rather than sold or exposed as a developer product; the company publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal, and directs external technology interest to enterprise partnership conversations.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Jones
providers.description: Jones is a full-service SaaS platform purpose-built for insurance compliance in construction and commercial real estate, unifying Certificate of Insurance (COI) collection, deep insurance auditing, workflow automation, and a licensed brokerage in one platform. It pairs hundreds of insurance specialists with AI agents to review COIs and policies at enterprise scale, and is used by general contractors, construction managers, owner-operators, REITs, property management teams, and insurance brokers to manage compliance across large portfolios of subcontractors, vendors, and tenants. Jones offers two engagement models: Jones Software (self-managed) and Jones Operator (an AI-driven concierge that runs day-to-day insurance tasks). Reported scale: 40,000+ projects, 3 billion+ square feet, and 50 million+ insurance documents processed for 300+ industry leaders. Headquartered in New York, NY, Jones was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Foundry Group.

providers.name: Nomad Homes
providers.description: Nomad Homes is a Partech-backed proptech company originally launched as a real-estate marketplace. It has since rebranded and pivoted to RemyAI (getremy.ai) — "the 24/7 intelligent assistant for real estate agents." RemyAI listens to agents' calls and texts, transcribes and summarizes them, auto-creates follow-up tasks and reminders, organizes buyer/seller contacts, and manages voicemail across iOS, Android, and desktop. The company's original domain nomadhomes.co now 301-redirects to getremy.ai. RemyAI publishes a public /.well-known/ai-plugin.json and an llms.txt describing the product, but it exposes NO public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal (its ai-plugin manifest explicitly declares api.type=none and auth.type=none).

providers.name: Omnee
providers.description: Omnee (Omnee AI) is a Techstars-backed startup providing an AI-powered customer care platform built for residential homebuilders. It pairs a per-home digital "home twin" data record with a personalized, multilingual AI assistant that handles buyer support and warranty management 24/7, claiming to increase warranty-department capacity by over 60%. Products are sold per-home (Warranty Triage, AI Customer Care, and an Enterprise Partner tier with custom integrations). The company operates a marketing and product website but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was enriched from its public site.

providers.name: Unison
providers.description: Unison (Unison Home Ownership Investors, headquartered in San Francisco with a second office in Omaha, and formerly FirstREX) is a residential home-equity investment manager that pioneered the equity sharing agreement and institutionalized the Home Equity Investment (HEI) asset class. Its consumer products are the Equity Sharing Agreement — up to roughly $500,000 in cash with no monthly payments and no interest, in exchange for a share of the home's future change in value over a 30-year term — and the Equity Sharing Home Loan, a fixed below-market-rate, interest-only mortgage. Unison securitizes its agreements and sells them to institutional investors, including a $300 million equity sharing home loan purchase partnership with Carlyle. It reaches homeowners through www.unison.com and services existing agreements through the MyUnison portal at my.unison.com. Unison publishes no public developer program, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind; the only agent-facing artifact it serves is an llms.txt at the site root.

providers.name: Century Communities
providers.description: Century Communities is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Century Communities API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: La Haus
providers.description: La Haus is a Latin American proptech company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Medellín and Bogotá, Colombia, that operates the residential real-estate marketplaces lahaus.com (Colombia) and lahaus.mx (Mexico) together with an in-house brokerage. The platform lists de-duplicated, verified new-construction and resale housing from vetted developers, adds mortgage and down-payment simulators, buyer guides and an AI assistant, and takes buyers through negotiation and closing at no cost to the buyer. It has raised more than $135M in equity plus debt facilities from Kaszek, NFX, Acrew Capital, Greenspring Associates, SoftBank and Bezos Expeditions. La Haus publishes NO public developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract: the consumer sites are server-rendered applications whose /api/* paths are disallowed in robots.txt, and api.lahaus.com is a private AWS API Gateway that answers every anonymous request with MissingAuthenticationToken. Partner/portal syndication runs through access-controlled marketing feed integrations (Trovit). This profile therefore records the company's public web surface and security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: PotlatchDeltic
providers.description: PotlatchDeltic is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The PotlatchDeltic API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Skyline Champion
providers.description: Skyline Champion is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Skyline Champion API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Kiavi
providers.description: Kiavi (formerly LendingHome) is a technology-driven private lender for residential real estate investors, providing fix-and-flip bridge loans, new-construction financing, and DSCR rental loans across 49 states plus Washington, D.C. The company has originated more than $30 billion in loans and funded over 100,000 investment properties, pairing a digital application and portfolio-management experience with institutional capital. Kiavi is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Kiavi publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, a real-estate-investing blog, legal/policy pages, and a HackerOne-based security vulnerability disclosure program.

providers.name: Matera
providers.description: Matera is a French proptech company providing a digital platform for condominium management (syndic de copropriété), rental property management (gestion locative), and real estate transactions. Founded in Paris, Matera lets co-owners self-manage their buildings with software backed by 200+ in-house accountants, lawyers, and works experts, plus embedded services such as building insurance, legal protection, and a Treezor-powered payment account. It serves 150,000+ co-owners across France and is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: Onefinestay
providers.description: Onefinestay is a British luxury hospitality company founded in 2009 that curates and manages a portfolio of upmarket private homes, villas, apartments and chalets for short-term and extended vacation rentals, pairing hand-picked properties with hotel-grade concierge service. AccorHotels acquired Onefinestay in 2016 for around $168 million; in 2025 Exclusive Resorts took a controlling operational stake while Accor retained a majority interest. Onefinestay operates as a consumer travel brand with a booking website and a technical/engineering organization on GitHub, but it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK program, or developer portal. This profile is maintained as a network company record.

providers.name: Propseller
providers.description: Propseller is a Singapore-based, technology-powered real estate brokerage founded in 2018 by Adrien Jorge. It helps property owners sell, buy, and rent residential real estate — HDB flats, condominiums, and landed homes — pairing top-performing human property agents with data and technology to deliver an end-to-end transaction experience at a transparent commission starting from 1%. Backed by Vertex Ventures and Partech, Propseller operates a consumer-facing real estate service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or programmatic integration surface.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Croissant
providers.description: Croissant is the workspace infrastructure layer for distributed teams, letting companies find, book, and manage on-demand access to 700+ coworking spaces across 100+ cities without long-term leases. Founded in 2015, the platform pairs instant workspace booking with spend governance, centralized policy controls, vendor consolidation, and usage-intelligence reporting, giving finance and people teams real-time control over where and how their people work. Croissant serves early-stage, scaling, and enterprise organizations, and exposes Slack, HRIS, stipend, and ERP integrations plus a custom API and integrations on its enterprise tier.

providers.name: Konn Technologies
providers.description: Konn Technologies is an Amman, Jordan based design and construction technology company, founded in 2020, that builds three integrated systems for a new model of homeownership - a composable architectural design language, an industrialized construction methodology using reinforced concrete and insulated sealed envelopes, and a software platform connecting the entire homeowner journey from first idea to keys in hand. Its consumer brand, Konn (konnhomes.com), sells that system directly to homeowners through a productized ladder - DesignFit, a 300 JOD ten-day land assessment producing 2D layouts, a site plan, and a budget and timeline; ArchDesign, a 4,000 JOD 3D design with a locked-in construction price; and Konnify, which adapts a design a homeowner already commissioned from an outside architect onto the Konn engineering system. Customer-facing software includes a Design Studio for browsing floor types, sizes, and styles with plans and pricing, and a Design Match tool that recommends a home design from stated requirements. The company reports 100+ homes designed and 35+ homes built, with typical permit-to-move-in timelines of three to six months. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mr. Cooper Group
providers.description: Mr. Cooper Group (formerly Nationstar Mortgage, NASDAQ: COOP) was a Coppell, Texas-based mortgage servicer with roughly $1.5T in unpaid principal balance under servicing and more than 4 million customers. It was acquired by Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT) in an all-stock transaction announced March 31, 2025 (initial value $9.4B) and closed October 1, 2025 (final value approximately $14.2B). Mr. Cooper now operates as a Rocket Companies subsidiary; the corporate site mrcoopergroup.com redirects to rocketcompanies.com and the COOP ticker has been delisted. The consumer brand Mr. Cooper continues at mrcooper.com as one of seven Rocket Companies operating businesses (Rocket Mortgage, Redfin, Mr. Cooper, Rocket Homes, Rocket Close, Rocket Money, Rocket Loans). Mr. Cooper does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Automax Ai
providers.description: Automax AI is a fintech company delivering AI-native residential property appraisals built for modern mortgage lending and the UAD 3.6 standard. Lenders order signed residential appraisals directly from their loan origination system (LOS) and get them back in days rather than weeks, combining AI-assisted market data analysis with licensed appraiser review. The platform pairs a hybrid appraisal workflow (automated mobile data capture of floor plans and photos plus human quality review) with an Appraisal Copilot report-writing and analysis suite, automated appraiser matching and assignment, nationwide licensed-appraiser coverage, and real-time order status tracking. Automax AI is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes web and mobile applications (an appraiser Copilot at copilot.automax.ai and an iOS app) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pine
providers.description: Pine is a Canadian digital-first mortgage lender and real estate brokerage (Pine Canada Financial Corporation / Pine Real Estate Brokerage) that makes home buying more accessible for Canadians through an online platform offering low interest rates, fast pre-approvals, and zero hidden fees. Backed by Greylock, Pine pairs mortgage origination with a REALTOR-affiliated brokerage licensed across multiple provinces (ON, AB, SK, NS, NB, NL), and reports more than $2B in mortgages funded and 100,000+ clients served. Pine is a consumer fintech product with no public developer API; its backend at api.pine.ca is a private, authenticated service.

providers.name: Rollins
providers.description: Rollins is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Rollins API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Apartment List
providers.description: Apartment List is a virtual-first online rental marketplace that helps renters find apartments across all 50 U.S. states. Founded in September 2011 by John Kobs and Chris Erickson, the platform uses an AI-driven "Perfect Match" recommendation engine to pair renters with listings based on budget, location, amenities, and lifestyle preferences, and offers a Partner Portal for property managers and landlords to list and manage units. The company runs a consumer-facing search experience alongside a B2B property-management side. Apartment List does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface.

providers.name: Brick&Bolt
providers.description: Brick&Bolt (bricknbolt.com) is a Bangalore-based, tech-enabled home and commercial construction marketplace that delivers end-to-end design-to-build services across major Indian cities including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi NCR, and Mysuru. The company connects homeowners with vetted contractors and manages projects through its QASCON quality system (470+ quality checks), an ESCROW-secured payment model that releases funds only as milestones complete, transparent quotations, and consumer and professional mobile apps for real-time project tracking. Backed by Accel, Brick&Bolt has delivered thousands of homes and was named to Forbes Asia's "100 to Watch" list. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Brick&Bolt operates a consumer construction platform and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: California Forever
providers.description: California Forever is a real estate and urban development company founded by Jan Sramek in 2017, backed by prominent Silicon Valley investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Laurene Powell Jobs, Reid Hoffman, Marc Andreessen, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Through its subsidiary Flannery Associates the company assembled roughly 60,000-70,000 acres of land in southeastern Solano County, California, and is planning a new walkable city for up to 400,000 residents alongside the Solano Foundry advanced manufacturing park and the Solano Shipyard. The company describes the effort as a $215 billion private investment intended to create hundreds of thousands of jobs, 170,000+ new homes, and billions in annual tax revenue over 40 years. California Forever is a physical-development and land-use company; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable interfaces at this time.

providers.name: Clikalia
providers.description: Clikalia is a Spanish proptech founded in 2018 by Alister Moreno and Pablo Fernandez that operates an iBuyer model for residential real estate: it makes homeowners an instant purchase offer, can close a sale within days, then renovates and returns properties to the market in turnkey condition. The company pairs proprietary technology with a large operations team to digitize a historically slow home buying and selling process, and also offers mortgage brokerage (hipotecas) and renovation services (Studio by Clikalia). Backed by Fifth Wall and SoftBank Vision Fund, Clikalia operates across Spain, Portugal, France and Mexico. Clikalia does not publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, legal, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Dwelly
providers.description: Dwelly (legal entity PROSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES LTD, also trading as Dwelly Group) is a UK-based, AI-first lettings and property-management company founded in 2023 by Ilya Drozdov (CEO), Dan Lifshits (CPO) and Dmitry Khanukov (CTO). Rather than selling software, Dwelly grows by acquiring independent UK lettings agencies and succession-planning their owners out, then running the acquired books on its own AI-powered operating platform. That platform automates tenant find (self-service enquiry chat, virtual viewings, verified offers), banking-grade tenant screening (KYC, Right to Rent, referencing), Direct Debit rent collection with automatic reconciliation and arrears handling, maintenance and property management workflows with centralised communications, and continuous lettings compliance. Dwelly is backed by General Catalyst, Begin Capital and S16VC. As of this profile Dwelly publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or technical documentation — the platform is operated internally for its own and its acquired agencies' portfolios.

providers.name: Epic CleanTec
providers.description: Epic Cleantec is a San Francisco based water technology company that designs, builds and operates onsite water reuse systems for buildings. Its OneWater and OneWater Rain systems collect, treat and recycle a building's greywater, blackwater, rainwater and condensate onsite — recovering up to 95% of wastewater for non-potable uses such as toilet flushing, irrigation, cooling towers and laundry — alongside wastewater heat recovery and a soil amendment product line. The technology grew out of work on the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation Reinvent the Toilet Challenge and is deployed in multifamily, commercial office, hospitality, stadium, data center, higher education and community-scale developments across North America. Systems ship with PLC/SCADA control and a cloud-connected Eco-Insights reporting dashboard for remote monitoring, alarms and utility savings reporting, but Epic Cleantec publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; the data surface is delivered to building owners and operators as a hosted dashboard rather than as a public API.

providers.name: Habi
providers.description: Habi is a Colombian real estate technology company (proptech) that operates as a direct home buyer and seller — an iBuyer model where Habi itself purchases apartments in cash, typically within 10 days, rather than acting as a traditional agency. It operates across Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla and 20+ Colombian cities and is expanding into Mexico. Products include Habimetro (an online property valuation simulator), property listings and search, Habi Credit (mortgage financing), Habi Inmobiliaria (assisted longer-term sales), and an allied-agent partner network. The company reports 40,000+ families served, 4,000+ allied real estate agents, and 550+ real estate experts. Backed by Homebrew. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from Habi's public surface; the company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: HomeVision
providers.description: HomeVision is an AI-powered collateral underwriting and appraisal quality-control platform for mortgage lenders and appraisal management companies (AMCs). Its MIRA platform pairs machine intelligence with human review to transform unstructured appraisal content — narrative commentary, sketches, photos and addenda — into structured, review-ready data using OCR, large language models, natural language processing and computer vision, and integrates with popular LOS and AMS platforms plus external data such as public records and MLS. Founded in 2019 and based in San Francisco, HomeVision is backed by Initialized Capital and Newark Venture Partners, and offers private API integration to customer order-management systems (no public developer portal).

providers.name: HouseEazy
providers.description: HouseEazy is an Indian proptech startup, founded in 2021 by Tarun Sainani and Deepak Bhatia, that runs a full-stack platform for buying and selling ready-to-move, pre-owned residential homes across the Delhi NCR region (Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram). It uses an AI/ML-based pricing algorithm built on over two million on-ground data points — registry records, market trends, and recent transactions — to price properties instantly, then pairs that with 3D walkthroughs, drone imagery, and virtual staging to make resale transactions fast, transparent, and secure. HouseEazy also offers LoanEazy home financing and a channel-partner program, and is backed by Accel, Antler, and DTU-IIF. It is a consumer-facing web application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Improovy
providers.description: Improovy is a Chicago-based prop-tech startup and digitally-native managed marketplace that connects homeowners with vetted, professional painters and controls the end-to-end residential and commercial painting experience. Founded in 2019 by CEO Andre Kazimierski, a third-generation tradesman, the platform offers instant online quotes and covers interior and exterior house painting, cabinet painting, drywall and plaster repair, staining, power washing, and specialty finishes across markets in Illinois, Michigan, Colorado, Florida, and Wisconsin. Improovy is a consumer service brand with no public developer program or API; this profile captures its web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kasa
providers.description: Kasa is a tech-enabled hospitality company operating a curated collection of furnished apartments and boutique hotels across dozens of U.S. cities. Its asset-light model partners with multifamily property owners and hotel operators to run flexible short-term, extended-stay, and corporate accommodations, layering a proprietary technology platform on top for contactless check-in, a virtual front desk, remote guest support, and unit operations. Kasa also serves corporate housing and corporate travel programs. Backed by Ribbit Capital, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a proptech/hospitality provider; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nawy
providers.description: Nawy is an Egyptian proptech real estate marketplace that lets users buy, sell, rent, and invest in premium property across Egypt, listing 15,000+ properties and 800+ compounds with search, virtual tours, mortgage financing, and its "Nawy Now" instant-purchase and part-exchange offerings. It operates a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, and developers; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or partner integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nexii
providers.description: Nexii is a green construction technology company that designs and manufactures prefabricated wall and roof panel systems for commercial and industrial buildings. Its panels are made from Nexiite, a proprietary low-carbon building material the company says is up to 80% lighter than conventional concrete, and bolt together on site to cut build times by as much as five times while producing near-zero construction waste. Nexii serves retail, residential, warehouse, data center, cold storage, healthcare, office and education verticals, with projects for Starbucks, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, Popeyes, Dutch Bros, Walmart and Marriott. The original Vancouver-based Nexii Building Solutions entered creditor protection in January 2024; Dallas-based 3 Gates acquired its assets in a court-approved sale completed 28 June 2024 and relaunched the business as NEXII, Inc., headquartered in Dallas, Texas with manufacturing in Squamish, British Columbia. Nucor Corporation subsequently made a strategic equity investment. Nexii is a manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Own Up
providers.description: Own Up is an AI-driven mortgage marketplace that helps borrowers shop for home loans by comparing personalized rate offers from a network of top-rated lenders without hard credit checks or sales pressure. It provides real-time rate comparisons, personalized recommendations, pre-approval letters, and educational resources for both home purchases and refinancing. Own Up is not a lender or bank; it arranges loans and is compensated by third-party lenders whose offers appear on the platform. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Proportunity
providers.description: Proportunity is a London-based proptech/fintech mortgage lender, founded in 2016 by Vadim Toader and Stefan Boronea, that helps first-time buyers get onto the property ladder with a shared-equity loan. The Proportunity Loan supplements a buyer's deposit and can boost purchasing power by up to GBP 150,000, letting buyers secure a home with as little as a 5% deposit on any property on the market (not just new-builds). The company uses machine-learning models to forecast house prices and identify fair-valued homes in high-growth areas to reduce financing risk. Proportunity is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 716565). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer/API surface (consumer-facing product only).

providers.name: Prypco
providers.description: PRYPCO is a Dubai-based PropTech platform building an integrated real estate ecosystem for the United Arab Emirates. Its products include Blocks (fractional property investment starting from AED 500), Mint (blockchain-based tokenized real estate buying, selling, and trading, run in partnership with the Dubai Land Department), Mortgage (instant pre-approval and mortgage comparison), Golden Visa application assistance, a general property buy/sell/rent management service, and One (an agent platform with listing and commission tooling). PRYPCO Real Estate LLC is registered in Dubai, UAE. The company operates a consumer web and mobile product surface and publishes no public developer API; this profile is a company identity record in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and awaiting any future developer/API surface.

providers.name: Rayonier
providers.description: Rayonier is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Rayonier API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Roomi
providers.description: Roomi is a consumer roommate- and room-rental matching platform that connects verified renters looking for roommates with people posting available rooms, sublets, spare rooms, and monthly rentals across more than 200 cities. The service offers a searchable listing experience with filters for amenities, duration, and property type, roommate verification and ID/background checks, an in-app booking and messaging system, and a safety-check service. Roomi is delivered primarily through free iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience built on Bubble.io, monetized through premium features such as background checks and listing boosts. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Service Corp International
providers.description: Service Corporation International (NYSE: SCI), headquartered in Houston, Texas, is North America's leading provider of deathcare products and services, owning and operating funeral homes and cemeteries across the United States and Canada. SCI markets its network under the Dignity Memorial brand, alongside Neptune Society and National Cremation, and sells funeral and cemetery services on both an at-need and a preneed basis. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Travelio
providers.description: Travelio is one of Indonesia's largest online property rental and management platforms, operated by PT Horizon Internusa Persada. It lists furnished and unfurnished apartments, houses, villas, guest houses, and hotel residences for daily, monthly, and yearly rental across 15+ Indonesian cities including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Bali, and Yogyakarta, and offers hospitality-grade property management for owners. Backed by 500 Global, Travelio runs consumer web and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, partner integration surface, or developer portal as of this profile.

providers.name: Truehold
providers.description: Truehold is a St. Louis, Missouri-founded residential real estate company that buys homes from owners and rents them back to those same owners through a residential sale-leaseback, letting a homeowner convert home equity into cash without moving. Launched in 2021, the company expanded across the Midwest and into the South and Southwest, and in 2025 added Truehold Financial, a Jacksonville, Florida-based lending arm offering DSCR loans, fix-and-flip financing and other investor lending products. Truehold also transacts portfolio sales and multifamily sales with real estate investors. Its public surface is a marketing and lead-generation website plus two authenticated web applications for customers and borrowers; it publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Vico
providers.description: Vico (getvico.com) is a Colombian marketplace for finding and renting furnished rooms, aparta-estudios, and apartments for shared, medium- to long-term stays across cities such as Bogotá and Medellín. Guests browse and book verified co-living spaces while hosts list and manage rooms, under the tagline "Ama donde vives" (Love where you live). It is a consumer-facing accommodation platform backed by 500 Global; it exposes no public developer API program, OpenAPI, GraphQL, or /.well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Cadre
providers.description: Cadre is a New York-based, technology-driven investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors access to private-market alternatives, historically centered on institutional-quality commercial real estate. Founded in 2014 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and Slow Ventures, Cadre now operates in partnership with Willow Wealth (Willow Wealth Markets LLC, a FINRA/SIPC broker-dealer formerly known as RealCadre LLC, and Willow Asset Management LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser) to offer diversified private-market funds alongside traditional stocks and bonds. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Cadre does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.
