providers.name: OnsiteIQ
providers.description: OnsiteIQ is a construction intelligence platform for real estate owners and developers that combines regular on-site 360-degree reality capture with AI-powered computer vision to monitor construction progress across trades and asset classes. The platform documents projects visually week over week, turns the imagery into searchable, measurable records, and surfaces analytics and actionable insights that teams use to verify progress, support payment applications, and make business-critical decisions on projects anywhere in the world. OnsiteIQ is a private company headquartered in New York City and backed by Anthemis and Bullpen Capital. As surfaced through the API Evangelist network, OnsiteIQ publishes a marketing and product website but does not expose a public developer API, documentation portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time; this profile records that honest state alongside the company's identity and public web properties.

providers.name: AirGarage
providers.description: AirGarage is a full-service parking management platform that helps property owners operate their parking lots and garages as revenue-generating real estate assets. The company combines proprietary data, full-service operations, and proactive pricing strategy: license plate recognition and aerial cameras capture real-time occupancy and compliance data, dynamic pricing automatically adjusts rates based on demand, aggregator marketing lists spaces across channels, on-the-ground teams handle real-time enforcement, and a managed driver-support operation processes mobile payments. Property owners get a real-time dashboard with transparency into revenue, occupancy, and market trends, on a revenue-share model with no long-term contracts. AirGarage is a portfolio company of a16z.

providers.name: Alude
providers.description: Alude is a Brazilian proptech (real estate technology) SaaS platform that digitizes the day-to-day operations of imobiliárias (real estate agencies), brokers, and property managers. Serving more than 20,000 agencies, the platform bundles rental management with automated payment collection and reporting, instant CPF/CNPJ tenant background screening (análise de ficha), legally valid electronic signatures without digital certificates, fast fire-insurance (seguro incêndio) issuance, automated property capture and lead generation, and capitalization bonds as an alternative to traditional rental deposits. Alude is LGPD-compliant, free to try without a credit card, and backed by Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and MAYA Capital. It operates as an end-to-end web application rather than a public API-first product; no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Belong
providers.description: Belong is a residential property-management platform serving both homeowners and renters across 25+ major U.S. cities. For homeowners it handles end-to-end rental management — home inspection, marketing, resident screening, rent collection, and maintenance — while for renters it offers rental-home discovery, flexible viewings, streamlined applications, and resident support. The company pairs AI-powered operations with human customer service. Belong is backed by a16z, Fifth Wall, and GGV Capital, and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. No public developer API or documentation surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: Ejari Co.
providers.description: Ejari (ايجاري) is a Riyadh-based property-technology and fintech company transforming the rental market in Saudi Arabia with a rent-now, pay-later (RNPL) model. Ejari pays a tenant's full annual rent to the landlord up front, then lets the tenant repay in twelve calm monthly installments, replacing the Kingdom's traditional single-cheque annual rent requirement. Founded in 2022 by Yazeed Al-Shamsi, Fahad Albedah, Mohammed Alkhelewy and Khalid Almunif, the company operates across 17+ Saudi cities and is building toward a full-service, Sharia-compliant real-estate super app. Ejari is backed by 500 Global and won the 2024 KPMG Global Tech Innovator competition.

providers.name: Qwikwire
providers.description: Qwikwire, now operating as Aqwire, is a Philippine-founded cross-border payments company backed by 500 Global that bridges international payers with Philippine recipients, with a primary focus on the real estate sector. The platform lets overseas home buyers and investors pay property developers in multiple currencies while handling collection, reconciliation, and delivery of Philippine pesos to local bank accounts. Aqwire for Enterprise provides a payment dashboard for creating payment links, tracking transactions in real time, running auto-debit enrollments, and receiving daily automated reports, plus the Aqwire Connect (Access) API so merchants can integrate payment transaction creation into their own applications. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: UrbanMetry
providers.description: UrbanMetry is a Malaysia-based big data analytics firm specialising in geospatial and urban intelligence for the property and real estate sector. It supports developers, financial institutions, government bodies, retailers, and public transport operators with property market intelligence, geo-behavioural analytics, and branch location analysis, alongside consumer products UrbanVault (multi-bank mortgage applications, in beta) and UrbanWave (home co-ownership and renovation funding). A World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, UrbanMetry publishes no public developer API, but its website exposes a live Wix Site MCP endpoint and llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Breezy
providers.description: Breezy is a Los Angeles-based proptech startup building what it calls the first independent AI operating system for residential real estate. Founded in 2024 by top-producing agent James Harris alongside Afterpay co-founders Nick Molnar and Anthony Eisen, the mobile-first app consolidates an agent's workflow — comparable market analysis (comps), AI meeting notes, deal-pipeline management, client insights and an AI assistant — into a single workspace, and adds an "UnderBuilt Radar" that uses zoning, geospatial and setback data to flag properties with unrealized development potential across 1,200+ cities. Breezy raised a $10M pre-seed led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Fifth Wall, DST Global Partners, Liquid 2 Ventures, O.G. Venture Partners, Fidji Simo and David Marcus. The company exposes no public developer API today; this profile tracks it as a Fifth Wall portfolio lead.

providers.name: Divvy Homes
providers.description: Divvy Homes is a San Francisco-based proptech company operating a rent-to-own home ownership program. A customer chooses a home on the open market, Divvy purchases it, and the customer moves in as a renter while a portion of each monthly payment builds toward a future down payment, giving aspiring buyers who are not yet mortgage-ready a path toward eventual ownership. The consumer web experience integrates third-party services such as Plaid for bank connectivity and Stripe for payments, but Divvy exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface of its own. This profile was surfaced from venture-portfolio data (a16z, Threshold Ventures) and enriched from Divvy's public consumer website only.

providers.name: ICON
providers.description: ICON Technology, Inc. is an Austin, Texas construction-technology company building large-scale robotic 3D printing systems, materials, and software to make home building faster, more affordable, and more resilient. Its flagship Titan 3D construction printer, orchestrated by the proprietary BuildOS software that translates architectural designs into robotic tool paths and manages material flow, can print the wall system of a 2,500 sq. ft. home in under seven days. ICON operates a Design + Build division delivering 3D-printed homes and communities, a Technology division selling its printers and building systems to other builders, the CODEX digital home design catalog, and ICON Prime. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Bond Capital and Pantera Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a venture-portfolio lead; ICON publishes a marketing and product presence but no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Juno
providers.description: Juno (juno.co), operated by Juno Technology, Inc., is a San Francisco-based owner's representation, development-consulting and construction-management firm for prefabricated, modular and mass-timber multifamily development, working with developers from site feasibility and entitlement through delivery across North America. Juno owns the rights to the Juno Mass Timber System, a field-tested kit-of-parts building system of roughly 33 components configurable into 25+ unit types, proven on the 24-unit Juno East Austin project at 400 Comal St, Austin TX. The current company is the 2024 relaunch ("Juno 2.0") of the venture-funded Juno / Juno Residential founded in 2019 by Jonathan Scherr, BJ Siegel and Chester Chipperfield, which raised roughly $32M from Comcast Ventures, Khosla Ventures and RET Ventures before running out of money; the relaunched firm is led by co-founders Emily Mills Marineau and Jen Canchola. Juno sells professional services and a physical building system, not software: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site, a mass-timber system page, a contact form, a newsletter signup, terms of service and a privacy policy, and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: LightBox
providers.description: Power your digital workflows using comprehensive property and location intelligence data from LightBox.

providers.name: Metro Residences
providers.description: MetroResidences is a serviced apartments and furnished-rentals platform offering flexible temporary housing for business travelers, expatriates, and relocating professionals. Its portfolio spans thousands of listings across Singapore, Tokyo, and Australia, ranging from studios to six-plus bedroom units in both furnished and unfurnished configurations, alongside select hotel accommodations. The company also runs a property-management offering that lets owners list and monetize their units. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site exposes no developer program, API, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Mint House
providers.description: Mint House is a US residential-hospitality operator founded in 2017 by Will Lucas that runs tech-enabled apartment-hotel units — full kitchens, workspaces and app-based check-in — in downtown districts of markets including New York, Miami, Nashville, Dallas, Washington DC, Houston, Phoenix and Madison. It raised a $35M Series B in May 2022 led by Mohari Hospitality with Revolution Ventures, Allegion Ventures and Ingleside Investors. In January 2026 Mint House entered an all-equity strategic combination with Kasa; the portfolio now operates as "Mint House by Kasa" and every corporate page on minthouse.com redirects to kasa.com. Mint House is a hospitality operator, not a software vendor: it publishes a consumer booking site and no public API, SDK, webhook or developer program of any kind.

providers.name: Realty Mogul
providers.description: RealtyMogul is a real estate crowdfunding and investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors online access to commercial real estate opportunities, including private placements, 1031 Exchange properties, and Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). The company performs due diligence on sponsors, business plans, and properties, and provides members with a secure website and online tools to evaluate and invest in professionally managed real estate. RealtyMogul publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Set Scouter
providers.description: Set Scouter is a location-scouting marketplace, built by former producers, that connects film, television, commercial, and branded-content productions with residential and commercial filming locations across North America. Producers browse film-ready spaces — kitchens, lofts, warehouses, mansions and more — arrange in-person scouts, and book online with payments, deposits and overtime handled by the platform, while property owners list their spaces to earn income from productions. The company operates from offices in Toronto and Los Angeles, serving markets including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Vancouver, Montreal and Atlanta.

providers.name: Vioo
providers.description: Vioo is a Mexican professional visual-content platform that connects businesses with a national network of 1,500+ certified photographers and creators across Mexico, delivering photography, videography, drone footage, 3D renders, and Matterport virtual tours. It serves real estate, gastronomy, e-commerce, hospitality, events, and portrait use cases with AI-assisted editing and 48-hour delivery, and offers scheduling either through a personalized form or automatically via an integration API. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Withco
providers.description: Withco, now operating as With at with.us (the original with.co domain 301-redirects there), is rebuilding main street one share at a time. The company helps small business owners buy the commercial buildings they operate in, stacking the owner's investment, seller financing, and community investor capital to meet the deal price, grounding offers in comparable sales, and giving each business a public investor page to tell its story to potential backers. Withco is a consumer/community real-estate platform and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: 99.co
providers.description: 99.co (99 Group) is a Singapore-headquartered real estate technology company and one of the largest property marketplaces in Southeast Asia. Founded in 2014 by Darius Cheung, Yan Phun and Conor McLaughlin, it operates consumer property portals across Singapore and Indonesia, including 99.co and SRX.com.sg in Singapore and 99.co/id and Rumah123.com in Indonesia. The platform lets buyers, renters and agents search HDB resale flats, executive condos, condominiums, landed homes and new-launch projects for sale and rent, with map-based search, transaction data, agent directories, mortgage tools and nearby-amenity insights (MRT, schools, commute times). 99 Group is backed by investors including Sequoia Capital, 500 Global, Golden Gate Ventures, Quest Ventures and East Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 99.co exposes consumer web products but publishes no first-party public developer API or portal at this time.

providers.name: Leadstate Incorporated
providers.description: Leadstate Incorporated is a New York City based real estate and design technology company, founded in 2021 and backed by 500 Global, that builds AI and AR tooling for how spaces are planned, developed, designed, and marketed. Its consumer-facing products are ReelProp, which turns static property photography and interior design sketches into marketing video reels, and RealMe In, which generates and manipulates 3D assets. The published product surface covers Photo-to-Video and Sketch-to-Video generation, CADgpt text-to-3D model generation, Image-to-3D asset conversion, and FloorPlan-to-3D visualization. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface of any kind, so this profile records verified company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: Lane
providers.description: Lane is a workplace experience platform for commercial real estate, now operated as VTS Activate after VTS acquired the company. The product gives building tenants a single mobile and web app for keyless building, suite and room access, booking amenities and shared spaces such as meeting rooms, fitness studios and desks, inviting and checking in visitors, receiving building information, maintenance updates and alerts, and RSVPing to events or ordering and paying for retail and food service. Landlords and property managers use it as the tenant-facing layer over the VTS commercial real estate platform. The legal entity behind the apps is VTS LANE INC. and the joinlane.com application traffic is served by the VTS Activate platform at activate.vts.com. Lane publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or SDKs; the product is delivered as a first-party mobile and web application backed by an internal GraphQL API.

providers.name: Argus Software
providers.description: Argus Software (ARGUS) is a commercial real estate software provider whose products are the industry standard for cash-flow modeling, valuation, asset and investment management, and development-project appraisal for owners, investors, lenders, and advisors. Founded in Houston, Texas and acquired by Altus Group in 2011, the ARGUS product line is now delivered through Altus Group as the ARGUS Intelligence platform and includes ARGUS Enterprise, ARGUS EstateMaster, ARGUS Developer, ARGUS Taliance, ARGUS ValueInsight, ARGUS Voyanta, and Forbury. ARGUS software is used across the global commercial real estate industry to underwrite acquisitions, perform discounted cash-flow analysis, run portfolio and fund analytics, and standardize valuations. As of this enrichment pass ARGUS exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or self-service API program; its cloud platform is accessed through the Altus Platform / ARGUS Cloud portal.

providers.name: Higharc
providers.description: Higharc is an AI-powered homebuilding software platform founded in 2018 by Marc Minor and headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, with team members across San Francisco and Atlanta. Its design-to-construction cloud platform lets residential builders design homes from scratch, configure market-proven plans, and turn every home into shoppable 3D visuals, plan-based estimating data, and permit-ready construction documents. The product surface spans Studio (design), Config (plan configuration), Showroom (3D visualization), Estimate (material takeoffs), Build (construction documents), Photoreal (renderings), and enterprise AI Estimating, unifying architecture, sales, and construction operations. Higharc is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Copperlane
providers.description: Copperlane is an AI-native mortgage loan origination platform founded in 2025 by Brianna Lin and Athan Zhang and backed by Y Combinator (W26 batch). Its AI agent, Penny, behaves like a real loan officer: it guides borrowers through intake, pulls and reads borrower documents, verifies loan eligibility in real time, answers borrower questions live, and generates Letters of Explanation, delivering cleaner files to human loan officers so they can focus on closing loans instead of chasing paperwork. The San Francisco company raised a $4.1M seed round to modernize a mortgage origination process that remains largely manual. Copperlane is currently a demo-request business application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Habito
providers.description: Habito is a UK-based digital mortgage broker that lets people research, compare, and apply for mortgages online across the whole of the market, pairing self-serve digital tools with human mortgage experts, alongside related home-buying services. Founded as a fintech in the consumer lending and real-estate space and backed by Ribbit Capital, Habito has since joined Monzo. The company operates a consumer web product (Webflow-hosted marketing site) and does not publish a public developer API program, developer portal, or OpenAPI at the time of this profile; this record is maintained by the API Evangelist network and reflects only publicly verifiable surfaces.

providers.name: huspy
providers.description: huspy is a UAE-based proptech and digital mortgage brokerage platform headquartered in Dubai that helps home buyers search residential property, compare mortgage rates across 20+ partner banks (including ADCB, ADIB, Emirates NBD, Dubai Islamic Bank, FAB, HSBC, Mashreq and RAK Bank), get pre-approved online, and close financing in as little as two weeks versus the usual two months. It also operates a broker portal and seller listing services (professional photography, videography and portal placement). No public developer API, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment; this profile remains a company stub with a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Jetty
providers.description: Jetty is a financial-services company built for the real estate industry, making renting more accessible and affordable for renters while helping property managers reduce risk and bad debt. Following its merger with Rhino, Jetty operates across more than 6 million rental units in the United States and offers three core products: Jetty Deposit, a security-deposit replacement that swaps large cash deposits for a low monthly or one-time payment; Jetty Protect, integrated renters insurance and liability coverage; and Jetty Credit, a rent-reporting and credit-building service that helps renters establish credit history while lowering delinquencies for property managers. Jetty is backed by Ribbit Capital. No public developer/API surface is currently published; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Pacaso
providers.description: Pacaso is a proptech company that operates a luxury vacation-home co-ownership platform, letting individuals buy a fractional share of a professionally managed second home. It handles the LLC ownership structure, financing, scheduling, cleaning, maintenance, and full property management for co-owners across premium destinations in the US, Europe, Mexico, and other resort markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. Pacaso publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Proper
providers.description: Proper (proper.ai) is an AI-powered, full-service property-management accounting and bookkeeping provider serving property managers, asset managers, and real estate developers. Rather than shipping software, Proper delivers a trained accounting team supported by automation to handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting, integrating with existing property-management systems such as AppFolio, Buildium, and RentManager. Founded in the property-management space in 2017, the company is backed by QED Investors, Redpoint Ventures, MetaProp, Expa, and Bling Capital. As of this enrichment pass Proper exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: Realm
providers.description: Realm is a consumer home-technology company that gives homeowners data-driven insights about their property's value and its renovation potential. The Realm platform combines public property records, permits, zoning, comparable sales, and neighborhood data into personalized recommendations that show which home improvement projects will add the most value, what they are likely to cost, and how they affect a home's estimated worth over time. Marketed at realmhome.com as "Home Renovation Planning & Home Value Insights," the product is delivered as a consumer-facing web and mobile experience rather than a developer platform. Realm was backed by venture investors including DCVC and GGV Capital and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Reposit
providers.description: Reposit is a UK-based PropTech and fintech company offering a deposit alternative for the residential rental market. Instead of paying a traditional cash deposit, tenants pay a one-time, non-refundable fee (typically one week's rent) for insurance-backed cover, while landlords and letting agents receive protection worth up to eight weeks' rent. The FCA-authorised product is underwritten by a leading insurer and serves letting agents, build-to-rent (BTR) operators, landlords and tenants, with integrations into common property management tools. This profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Reposit publishes no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Ryland Group
providers.description: The Ryland Group was one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and a leading mortgage finance company before merging with Standard Pacific Corp in October 2015 to form CalAtlantic Group, Inc., which was subsequently acquired by Lennar in 2018. During its operation, Ryland Homes built homes across 17 states and provided financial services including consumer mortgage loans, title, and escrow services. The company's technology stack included Akamai, Amazon CloudFront, ASP.NET, Fiserv for financial services, and Microsoft Dynamics for CRM and ERP.

providers.name: Sundae
providers.description: Sundae is a residential real estate marketplace that buys homes directly from homeowners for cash and resells them to a vetted network of property investors. Sellers get a competitive as-is cash offer with no repairs, showings, or fees, flexible closings in as little as 10 days, and an optional cash advance before closing; investors access off-market and distressed properties through the Sundae Marketplace. Backed by QED Investors, Sundae operates a consumer-facing website, an investor marketplace, and an agent referral program. It is a proptech/fintech company and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Welltower
providers.description: Welltower Inc. (NYSE: WELL) is an S&P 500 healthcare REIT that invests in senior housing, post-acute care, and outpatient medical properties across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. The company operates an internal operator portal at portaldev.welltower.com for property operators and partners. Welltower uses the Welltower Business System (WBS) and has integrated AI and data science capabilities including OpenAI. No public developer API has been identified; Welltower primarily uses internal proprietary systems for property management and operator coordination.

providers.name: UpEquity
providers.description: UpEquity is an Austin, Texas based, veteran-owned proptech mortgage lender and title company founded in 2019 that operates a "Buy Before You Sell" / Trade Up program for homeowners who are purchasing and selling at the same time. The company advances the equity trapped in a client's existing home so the client can make a non-contingent — effectively all-cash — offer on a new home, move once, and sell the old home afterward, with UpEquity making a backup offer on the departing residence. It also runs UpEquity Title and originates mortgages directly under NMLS #2101265, licensed across roughly twenty US states. Distribution is through real-estate agents and loan officers rather than a developer channel: as of this profiling pass UpEquity publishes no developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind on any host it controls.

providers.name: Vesta
providers.description: Vesta is an AI-native mortgage Loan Origination System (LOS) — a modern, open system-of-record platform that orchestrates the loan manufacturing process through configurable software workflows and AI agents that run real loans end to end. Founded in 2020 by former Blend employees Mike Yu and Devon Yang and headquartered in San Francisco, Vesta gives mortgage lenders a cloud, API-and-integration-friendly LOS to replace legacy origination systems, connecting to the broader mortgage technology ecosystem. The company raised an Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)-led Series A. Vesta sells to lenders through a demo/partner-signup enterprise motion and does not currently expose a public self-serve developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Doma
providers.description: Doma is a technology company transforming the mortgage closing process with an AI-first platform for title insurance, title and closing services, and title alternatives. Doma's technology aims to dramatically reduce the cost, time, and complexity of one of life's most confusing and expensive experiences—the mortgage process—serving lenders, mortgage brokers, real estate technology platforms, and homeowners. Doma is backed by Bloomberg Beta, Fifth Wall, and Uncork Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Flatlooker
providers.description: Flatlooker (founded 2016) is a French digital real-estate agency for online rental search, tenant placement, and full rental property management (gestion locative). It now operates under the Manda brand (formerly Flatlooker and Hello Syndic); flatlooker.com redirects to manda.fr. Manda covers rental and property management, sales, condominium (syndic) management, and energy renovation for owners, tenants, investors, and co-ownerships across France, working primarily online — remote viewings, electronic dossiers and signatures, and mobile apps to track properties in real time — while relying on local agents in Paris, Lyon, and Marseille. Flatlooker was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its live llms.txt and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Closing Theory Studios
providers.description: Closing Theory Studios, Inc. is an independent mobile game studio founded in 2023 and based in Austin, Texas, on a mission to bring the real world into games. Its debut title, Househunt (the officially licensed ZillowGoneWild game), lets the 70 million-plus people who browse Zillow for fun buy, guess prices on, renovate, flip, and manage real houses in a casual mobile experience aimed at "non-gamers." The studio was co-founded by Ankith Harathi and Nitin Rajinikanth and raised a $2.3M round led by a16z GAMES SPEEDRUN, with participation from Powerhouse Capital and angel Seth Sivak (founder of Proletariat, acquired by Blizzard). Closing Theory Studios ships consumer mobile games on iOS and Android and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Homeday
providers.description: Homeday is a German proptech real estate brokerage founded in 2015 and headquartered in Berlin, combining a nationwide network of local partner brokers with digital tools to help owners sell, buyers purchase, and both finance residential property across Germany. Its consumer products include free online and in-person property valuation, full-service sales brokerage, buyer representation, mortgage and financing brokerage through partner banks, and the Preisatlas transparent real estate price map for Germany. Homeday is backed by 500 Global and other investors. The company runs an active engineering organization on GitHub (homeday-de) publishing internal tooling, a Vue component library, design assets, and Ruby clients for third-party real estate APIs (ImmobilienScout24, onOffice), but does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or OpenAPI specification. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with identity, link-property, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: IAD
providers.description: IAD Group (I@D International) is a European real-estate network company that combines real estate, digital tools, and network marketing to digitalize the traditional agency model through a network of independent agents rather than brick-and-mortar offices. Founded in France, IAD operates across France, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Germany, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States (Florida), with roughly 20,000 independent agents, around 500 employees, more than 96,000 online property listings, and 521 million euros in 2025 turnover. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. IAD publishes a consumer/agent web presence but no public developer platform or API surface at this time.

providers.name: LJ Hooker
providers.description: LJ Hooker is one of the largest residential and commercial real estate brokerage and property management networks in Australia and New Zealand. Founded in Maroubra, Sydney in 1928, the franchise network reports 390 businesses and around 4,000 sales professionals, property managers and support staff, facilitated more than AUD$20 billion in property transactions during 2024, and manages roughly 100,000 properties valued at about AUD$82 billion on behalf of investors. It operates across residential sales and rentals (ljhooker.com.au), commercial (ljhcommercial.com.au), rural (ljhrural.com.au), land and projects (ljhland.com.au) and New Zealand (ljhooker.co.nz). LJ Hooker sits at the agency layer of the Australian property value chain — below the REA Group / Domain portal duopoly that distributes its listings, and upstream of PEXA electronic conveyancing and the PropTrack / CoreLogic valuation data concentration. Its API posture is honestly stated as none-published: there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no API terms of use and no partner or data-feed programme on any LJ Hooker domain. The only programmatic surface located is an undocumented, vendor-operated website backend at api01.ljx.com.au, generated by OpenAPI Generator and consumed by the Agentpoint-built property search front end; that OpenAPI definition is not published. RESO — the Real Estate Standards Organization Web API and Data Dictionary — is a North American, NAR-driven regime with no Australian footprint, and LJ Hooker appears nowhere in the RESO certificates directory.

providers.name: Pashouses
providers.description: Pashouses (PT Pionir Alfa Sejahtera) is an Indonesian proptech company operating an end-to-end transactional marketplace for buying and selling ready-to-occupy residential homes across the Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek) region — Jakarta, Tangerang, Tangerang Selatan, Bekasi, Bogor, and Depok. Founded in 2020 by Junghans Tasani and Bin Anindita, the platform combines an iBuyer model, brokerage, staging, and renovation with mortgage (KPR) origination through partnerships with major Indonesian banks (BCA, Mandiri, BSI, BRI). It offers consumer tools including a Smart Agent property assistant, a KPR mortgage calculator, and an affordability calculator. QED Investors led a $5M pre-Series B in November 2022 (its first Indonesian / Southeast Asian investment). The company exposes a consumer web marketplace only; no public developer, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Volter
providers.description: Volter (Get Volter Ltd) is a London-based energy platform that connects UK businesses with renewable generators to procure cheaper, greener electricity, and helps commercial real estate owners and generators deploy, optimize, and monetize rooftop solar and other onsite renewable assets. The platform spans renewable energy matching, solar optimization, and a forthcoming energy management suite with analytics, anomaly detection, flexible asset control, and battery storage. Backed by Transition and Seedcamp with a $3.2M pre-seed round in 2024. Volter does not currently publish a public API or developer documentation.

providers.name: Klaim
providers.description: Klaim (Klaim Kapital Technologies Limited / Klaim Holdings Limited) is an Abu Dhabi-founded, UAE-based healthcare fintech that advances working capital against receivables. Healthcare providers, real estate brokers and SMEs submit unpaid insurance claims or invoices, Klaim's AI evaluates and prices the risk in real time, and Klaim advances up to 90% of face value within 24 hours, collecting only when the payer or client settles. Products span Klaim Health (insurance claim advances plus AI denial prediction), Klaim Flow (SME receivables purchasing with an escrow model), Klaim Estate (real estate commission advances) and Klaim Eligible (insurance eligibility verification). Founded in December 2019 by Karim Dakki and Ahmad Ghafour, backed by Techstars, and operating across the GCC, North Africa and Turkey. Klaim publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API description at this time.

providers.name: LocateAI
providers.description: LocateAI (Locate) is an AI-integrated commercial real estate brokerage focused on retail site selection for multi-unit and franchise brands. Its platform pairs proprietary AI models with full-service advisory to help brands choose markets, source and score sites, forecast Year-1 revenue and cannibalization risk, right-size franchise territories, and negotiate leases — from the first market through the signed lease. The models analyze 200M+ mobile devices and 1,100+ variables for device-level trade-area, fair-share, and time-weighted revenue analysis. Locate is delivered as a managed service; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: Tomo Guides
providers.description: Tomo Guides is the home-buying guide and educational content produced by Tomo Mortgage (tomo.com), a consumer digital mortgage lender backed by a16z. Tomo offers home purchase mortgages and refinancing with $0 lender fees and rates advertised at roughly 0.25% below the market median, alongside its TrueRate tool that shows a fair rate before applying and state-by-state interest-rate pages. The "Guides" surface is Tomo's home-buying-guide blog content aimed at first-time and repeat buyers, not a developer product. As of this enrichment pass Tomo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, documentation site, or .well-known metadata; the company's web presence is entirely consumer-facing. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and is retained as a company record with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Ukio
providers.description: Ukio is a Barcelona-founded proptech company offering monthly furnished apartment rentals across Europe, with apartments in Barcelona, Madrid, Berlin, Lisbon, Milan, and Paris. It serves individuals relocating for work or lifestyle, provides corporate housing for companies, and partners with property owners through a real-estate property-management program. Backed by Partech. Ukio publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Enertiv
providers.description: Enertiv is a commercial real estate sustainability and decarbonization technology company serving owners and operators of large CRE portfolios. Its platform combines portfolio-scale utility data collection and ESG reporting (Report), asset-specific carbon planning that pairs AI recommendations with on-site equipment surveys (Decarbonize), and real-time monitoring with fault detection and operational optimization (Optimize). Additional workflow tools cover automated tenant utility billing and maintenance/work-order management, with integrations into property management systems such as Yardi and MRI. The company guarantees 100% utility data coverage — including tenant-controlled utilities — and has worked with 100+ large portfolios over more than fifteen years.

providers.name: Autositu
providers.description: Autositu (AutoSitu) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) PropTech startup building an AI-native intelligence layer for real estate development plan review. Its multi-agent platform automatically analyzes site plans, building plans, and AEC drawings against municipal zoning and building codes to flag compliance issues before submission, cutting city comments and resubmittals so approvals move faster. The product serves cities, architecture and engineering firms, and real estate developers with human-in-the-loop review workflows. Autositu is an early-stage SaaS company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Side
providers.description: Side is a technology-powered residential real estate brokerage platform that partners with top-producing agents, teams, and independent brokers to help them launch and grow their own branded brokerage companies without the time, cost, or risk of operating a traditional brokerage. Side provides back-office operations, compliance, transaction management, marketing, and a proprietary Side App that streamlines and automates real estate transactions. Founded in San Francisco, Side is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Matrix Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Side runs a private, authenticated internal API (api.side.com/v1) that powers its app but publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: MISMO
providers.description: MISMO — the Mortgage Industry Standards Maintenance Organization — is the standards development body for US real estate finance, founded in 1999 and a not-for-profit wholly owned subsidiary of the Mortgage Bankers Association since 2004. Its Reference Model defines the data of a loan from application through closing, servicing and the secondary market, and version 3.6 ships an XML schema, a Logical Data Dictionary, a Unique ID Matrix and a YAML file set that conforms to the OpenAPI Specification, alongside a MISMO API Toolkit and services such as a FIPS Code API. Around the Reference Model sit sixteen dataset specifications — iLAD, the Mortgage Compliance Dataset, the IRS 4506-C, the VA forms, adverse action, closing instructions — plus SMART Doc and the eMortgage and eNote work, and certification programmes for RON, eClosing, eVault and SMART Doc systems. MISMO standards are accepted and deployed by every type of entity involved in creating mortgages and are required by most regulators, housing agencies and the GSEs. It governs in the open — fourteen bodies and their rosters are published — and distributes behind a $3,500 annual membership and a licence agreement, which is the exact inverse of the specifications-as-code posture CAMARA and NMFTA took.

providers.name: Officebanao
providers.description: Officebanao is a technology-enabled office interior design and build company headquartered in Gurugram and Bengaluru, India, and founded in 2021. It delivers turnkey commercial workspace solutions — space planning, interior design, furniture procurement, office renovation, and end-to-end project execution — for startups, enterprises, and coworking spaces across 40+ Indian cities. Its "Tech plus Touch" delivery model pairs real-time 3D visualization and online progress tracking with an in-house team of designers and project managers. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Officebanao publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer platform surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Century 21 Canada
providers.description: CENTURY 21 Canada Limited Partnership is the Canadian master franchisor of the CENTURY 21® real estate brand, headquartered at 1285 West Pender Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The master licence for Canada was secured in Vancouver in 1976 — the first international franchise of the CENTURY 21 System — and the network today spans roughly 400 independently owned and operated offices from coast to coast. Century 21 Canada sits in the brokerage/franchisor layer of the Canadian real estate value chain: it does not originate listing data, it consumes it. Canadian residential listings are consolidated nationally by the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA), which runs REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF®); franchisors and brokerages redistribute that member-owned MLS® content under CREA rules rather than publishing it themselves. Century 21 Canada's API posture is accordingly empty. As of a 2026-07-26 probe there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no published base URL, no SDK, no webhooks, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind on century21.ca or c21.ca — both century21.ca and c21.ca resolve to the same WordPress consumer site whose terms of use name MoxiWorks LLC as the site operator, and whose property search is a hosted MoxiWorks Web Marketing System surface rather than a first-party API. Wildcard DNS on *.century21.ca and *.c21.ca returns HTTP 200 for every subdomain probed (developer., developers., api., docs.) by parking them all on eboat.moxiworks.com, so those 200s are a DNS artifact and not a developer portal. RESO is absent: no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData or $metadata endpoint, and no Universal Property Identifier reference appears anywhere in the public surface — consistent with Canada, where RESO certification is not the operative seam and CREA's DDF® is. The only genuinely public, anonymously callable machine-readable surface found is the incidental WordPress REST API route index at https://www.c21.ca/wp-json/, which is a CMS artifact, is undocumented by Century 21 Canada, and is deliberately not listed here as a product API. Agent- and franchisee-facing tools live behind the hub21.ca member login. This profile is therefore identity-only and honestly records a brokerage franchisor with no published developer surface.

providers.name: Pellego
providers.description: Pellego is a real estate technology and brokerage platform serving real estate professionals including agents, contractors, flippers, landlords, lenders, and wholesalers. It offers property analysis software (comparable sales analysis, rehab calculators, and investment filtering), a 100% commission brokerage for agents who hang their license, an agent marketplace connecting investors with experienced agents, and deal discovery for flips, rentals, and assumable loans. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Savills
providers.description: Savills plc is a London-headquartered global real estate advisor, established in 1855, listed on the London Stock Exchange, with more than 42,000 people in over 70 countries. It sits on the advisory side of the property value chain rather than the data-platform side: commercial and prime residential agency, transaction advisory and capital markets, valuation and professional services, building and project consultancy, property and facilities management, rural and agricultural advisory, occupier services, the Savills Research publication programme, and a separate fund manager in Savills Investment Management. Its home market is the United Kingdom, where there is no MLS and no cooperative listing standard — residential stock reaches consumers through the Rightmove and Zoopla duopoly by way of agency CRM software (Reapit, Alto, Street, Apex27) rather than a shared cooperative pool. Savills is a supplier into that pipe, not an operator of it. Its API posture is the honest null case for this sector. Savills publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind: developer., developers., docs. and apis.savills.com do not resolve, /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /api-docs on savills.com, savills.co.uk and savills.us all return 404, and no OpenID Connect discovery document is served. Undocumented internal service hosts do exist behind the consumer property search — livev6-searchapi, livev6-authentication and livev6-profile.savills.com, named in the search application's own endpoints.js — but every one of them returns 404 to an anonymous client and none is described anywhere public. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document and no Universal Property Identifier anywhere in the Savills estate; RESO is a North American NAR/MLS construct and the UK has nothing to certify against. Savills publishes no open data either — its research output is PDF and web narrative, and the genuinely open UK property layer belongs to the public sector (HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and Ordnance Survey), not to the brokerage. For a developer there is no gate to pass, because there is no door: the only published route is the corporate contact form.

providers.name: CohnReznick
providers.description: CohnReznick is a top-25 US accounting, tax, and advisory firm formed in 2012 by the merger of J.H. Cohn LLP and Reznick Group, P.C. The firm serves clients across more than 30 industries from offices throughout the United States and four offshore subsidiaries, with its global reach extended through membership in the Nexia International network (operating in more than 128 countries). In May 2024 CohnReznick became the first US accounting firm of its scale to receive a strategic growth investment from a private equity sponsor when funds advised by Apax Partners acquired a majority stake. As part of that transaction the firm operates under an alternative-practice structure: audit and attest services are delivered by CohnReznick LLP (a licensed CPA firm) while tax and advisory services are delivered through CohnReznick Advisory LLC. Largest practice areas include Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Government Contracting, Asset Management (private equity, hedge funds, private credit, REITs), Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer & Industrial, Technology & Media, Public Sector, and Private Clients (family offices, high net worth individuals, professional sports). CohnReznick does not publish a public software developer API; this repository documents the firm's organizational profile, practice taxonomy, and linked-data context for API catalog purposes.

providers.name: Freemodel
providers.description: Freemodel is a presale home renovation platform that helps real estate agents and homeowners prepare properties for sale by coordinating design, renovation, and project management through local project directors. It offers pay-at-close financing so clients can defer renovation costs until the home sells, and provides transparent online project tracking. Freemodel operates across Northern California (Bay Area, Sonoma, Santa Cruz/Monterey) and Southwest Florida. This profile was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Freemodel publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: hallo theo
providers.description: Hallo theo (rebranding to "Theo") is a German residential property management company (Hausverwaltung) that manages homeowners' associations (WEG/HOA), rental apartment buildings, and commercial properties across Germany. With 150+ experts and local teams in Berlin, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Stuttgart, and Wildeshausen, the company manages over 20,000 units and is Section 26a HOA-certified, combining on-the-ground regional teams with central specialists in law, technology, and finance. Backed by Insight Partners, it offers HOA management, property management, commercial property management, succession, and sale-and-stay-on services to co-owners and building owners. This is a services company with a marketing/lead website (built on Framer + HubSpot); it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: New Story
providers.description: New Story is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit building a housing market that helps vulnerable families in Latin America become homeowners. It develops underused land into affordable communities, enables families to own land, and connects them to credit and home financing. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15), New Story has housed thousands of people across Haiti, Bolivia, Mexico, and El Salvador, partnered with ICON to build the first community of 3D-printed homes, and reports outcomes like 60% of land titles going to women and a 100% portfolio repayment rate. Its impact-investing arm operates as New Story Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; New Story publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: PropTiger
providers.description: PropTiger.com is one of India's leading online real estate advisory and transaction platforms, founded in 2011 and now part of the REA India group (alongside Housing.com). It helps home buyers discover, evaluate, and purchase residential property across major Indian cities, combining property search and locality research with on-ground advisory, legal paperwork guidance, and home-loan assistance. The public surface is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this enrichment pass PropTiger publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server. This profile captures verifiable company identity, published consumer pages, and live domain-security posture. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Reno
providers.description: Reno (Reno Home) is a Dubai, UAE based one-stop home renovation platform that connects homeowners and businesses with professional interior designers and vetted contractors, managing renovation projects end-to-end from design and contracting through quality inspections and completion. Its Reno mobile app lets clients track project progress, budgets, timelines and change requests in real time, and it offers a "Renovate Now, Pay Later" financing model with 3, 6 or 12 month installment plans. Reno is backed by 500 Global (500 Sanabil), Hub71 and other regional investors. It is a consumer-facing service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Spacee
providers.description: Spacee Inc. (株式会社スペイシー) is a Tokyo-based space-sharing and rental marketplace operator in Japan. Its consumer platforms let people discover and book temporary spaces by the hour: Yoyappin, a booking marketplace for meeting rooms, conference rooms, studios, kitchens and event venues across the Tokyo metropolitan area; THE POINT, a premium coworking and creative "third place" for remote workers; and Office Connect, a nationwide search service for shared offices, rental offices, coworking spaces and virtual offices. Spacee also expands via partnerships (e.g. JR West Japan) and acquisitions (GYYM pay-per-use fitness). It operates as a consumer web and mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Campus Apartments
providers.description: Campus Apartments is a privately held student housing developer, owner, and operator headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1958, the company originally served students of the University of Pennsylvania and has grown into one of the largest privately held student housing companies based in the United States, operating over 145 properties across more than 25 states with a portfolio of roughly 70,000 beds. The firm is led by CEO David J. Adelman and operates alongside affiliated brand presence historically associated with the Campus Crest student housing portfolio. Campus Apartments does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI documentation, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: ResWare
providers.description: ResWare is customizable title and escrow production software for real estate closings, originally built by Adeptive Software Corporation and acquired by Qualia Labs in December 2020 (now shipping as ResWare 10 within the Qualia ecosystem). It is an on-premises, workflow-driven platform covering title and escrow production, document management and auto-generation, secure communications, and escrow accounting. ResWare exposes an integration API to partners and customers that is historically a SOAP/XML web-service API (built on Windows Communication Foundation / WCF, Microsoft binary protocol by default with Basic Authentication available on request), complemented by newer REST APIs for document handling. There is no public, self-serve developer portal - API access is gated behind a partner/integration program and an "API assistance" package (developer support hours, REST/WCF code samples, and documentation), with pricing on request via sales@adeptivesw.com. The logical service areas below are modeled from partner-integration behavior; ResWare publishes no public API reference or OpenAPI, so no REST surface is fabricated here.

providers.name: Brandywine Realty Trust
providers.description: Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE: BDN) is a publicly traded, fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) headquartered at Cira Centre in Philadelphia. The company owns, develops, leases, and manages a roughly 22 million square foot portfolio of office, life science, mixed-use, multifamily, retail, and education properties concentrated in the Greater Philadelphia, Austin, and Washington, D.C. markets. Brandywine is the developer behind Schuylkill Yards, uCity Square, Uptown ATX, Broadmoor, and Discovery Point, and has delivered roughly $2.6 billion and 12.1 million square feet of ground-up developments, master-planned communities, and adaptive reuse projects over a 30+ year operating history.

providers.name: Workplaced Technologies Ltd
providers.description: Workplaced (Workplaced Technologies Ltd) is a workplace-strategy and hybrid-work SaaS platform that helps companies create workplaces that work. Its products cover workplace experience surveys (Dynamics), office occupancy measurement beyond sensor data (Occupancy), space taxonomy and office planning (Taxonomy), desk and meeting-room booking (Booking), and hybrid work policy modelling (Balance), alongside a pricing calculator, free planning tools, research reports, and a partner program. Workplaced is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public developer program - the api.workplaced.com backend is fully authentication-gated with no public documentation or specification.

providers.name: Assembly OSM
providers.description: Assembly OSM is a New York City off-site manufacturing company founded in 2019 by SHoP Architects co-founders Bill and Chris Sharples to industrialise the construction of high-rise urban housing. The company calls its method "post-modular": rather than trucking finished volumetric boxes from a single factory, Assembly designs a kit-of-parts chassis and distributes fabrication across a network of specialist suppliers — an aerospace and automotive supply-chain model applied to buildings — then stacks the resulting units on site, claiming delivery of market-competitive high-rise residential architecture in roughly 60% of conventional schedule. Its buildings are all-electric and passive-design led, targeting 55-70% energy-efficiency improvement and 35% less embodied carbon today, net-zero operational carbon by 2027 and climate-positive buildings by 2040. Completed and in-progress work includes Prototype Alpha, 147 St. Felix Street and 247 East 117th Street in New York, plus an AOSM Canada operation. The company has raised more than $60 million, including a $38 million Series A in 2022, and draws engineering staff from SpaceX, Tesla and Boeing. Assembly runs a digital-twin engineering platform — a heavily scripted CATIA environment carrying each module from design through fabrication to installation — but that platform is an internal manufacturing tool, not a product: Assembly OSM sells buildings, and publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Point
providers.description: Point (Point Digital Finance, Inc.) is a San Francisco fintech founded in 2015 by Eddie Lim, Eoin Matthews, and Alex Rampell that gives homeowners access to their home equity without monthly payments or income requirements. Its flagship Home Equity Investment (HEI) provides lump sums up to $600,000 in exchange for a share of a home's future appreciation over a 30-year term, alongside a HELOC product offering lines up to $750,000. Point has served more than 25,000 homeowners and facilitated over $2 billion in home equity investments, and is backed by a16z, Bloomberg Beta, and Ribbit Capital. Point is a consumer-facing platform with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline (identity + domain-security probe only — no API surface found).

providers.name: Propmatic
providers.description: PropMatic (PropMatic Inc.) is an AI-powered residential leasing platform that helps property managers and multifamily operators lower cost-per-lease across both traditional and AI-driven discovery channels. Its three products are AI Smart Sites (dynamic, search-optimized landing pages), an AI Concierge chatbot that engages, nurtures, and converts prospects into residents, and an AI-to-AI hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) service that structures a client's listings, data, and APIs so AI assistants such as ChatGPT can find, recommend, and act on inventory and even schedule tours. The platform integrates with existing property-management, CMS, and CRM tools. PropMatic is a proptech portfolio company backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: Ventas
providers.description: Ventas, Inc. is an S&P 500 healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT) and one of the largest owners of senior housing communities, medical office buildings, life science research facilities, and health system facilities in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom. Ventas operates the Ventas OI proprietary data platform for operational intelligence across its portfolio of approximately 1,400 properties. Ventas does not offer a public developer API; data access is available through financial data providers and SEC EDGAR filings.

providers.name: Wunder
providers.description: Wunder (formerly Wunder Capital, wewunder.com, now wunderpower.com) is a commercial clean-energy company that deploys solar, battery storage, and EV charging infrastructure across real estate portfolios with no-CapEx energy solutions, managing projects from design through operations in 40+ US states. Backed by Techstars and a $650M partnership with Blackstone, Wunder runs its project development on Astra, a proprietary internal platform for energy data analysis, forecasting, and automation. Wunder publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Vornado Realty Trust
providers.description: Vornado Realty Trust (NYSE: VNO) is a fully integrated Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) focused on owning and operating premier office and retail properties in New York City. With nearly 20 million square feet of office space and over 2.4 million square feet of Manhattan street retail, Vornado is among the largest commercial real estate companies in the United States. The company also owns residential units, marketplaces, and advertising signage in Times Square and Pennsylvania Station.

providers.name: @Stake
providers.description: Stake (Stake Technologies, Inc., NMLS #2535498) operates the "Return on Rent" cash-back network for renters. Renters earn cash back on their rent payments, build credit history through on-time payments, unlock exclusive local deals, and access banking services including an FDIC-insured checking account and debit card provided through banking partner Midland States Bank. Co-founded by Rowland Hobbs and Jimmy Jacobson, the platform reports more than 550,000 homes in its network and over $50M in cash back earned by renters, averaging roughly $350 per renter annually. Stake is a consumer-facing fintech product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (surfaced under Battery Ventures).

providers.name: Buena
providers.description: Buena (Buena GmbH) is a Berlin-based modern property management company serving real estate owners across Germany, managing over 70,000 units. It provides WEG (condominium / Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaft) management, rental property management (Mietverwaltung), and property-management succession (Nachfolge) for owners seeking an alternative to conventional, reactive administrators. Buena positions itself as a technology-forward, proactive Hausverwaltung. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Buena publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation — this profile captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Habyt
providers.description: Habyt is a flexible-living and co-living accommodation provider offering furnished studios, apartments, and private rooms for stays ranging from a single night to several months. Positioned as "a new category of living for people in motion," the company blends hotel-style service and amenities with residential flexibility, targeting mobile professionals, relocators, and long-term travelers. Habyt operates properties across Europe (Berlin, Madrid, Vienna, with Lisbon and Milan announced) and Asia (multiple locations in Singapore), and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital. Habyt is a consumer real-estate and hospitality operator rather than an API-first technology provider; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Khmer Home
providers.description: Khmerhome (khmerhome.com) is Cambodia's real estate marketplace, based in Phnom Penh, connecting buyers, renters, and property owners across houses, apartments, condos, villas, boreys, land, warehouses, and commercial spaces. The platform offers property search and browsing, sales and rental listings with photos and agent details, property valuation and appraisal tools, an articles section covering Cambodian economic and property developments, and community events for real estate professionals and expats. Khmerhome ships native iOS and Android mobile apps and operates alongside sister sites khmerload.com and khmercars.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer/API surface, OpenAPI specification, or documentation portal has been found at this time.

providers.name: Estately
providers.description: Estately is a Seattle-based, MLS-based residential real estate search platform for browsing homes for sale, recently sold homes, home values, and neighborhood information, and for connecting buyers and sellers with agents. Estately does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its notable developer-facing surface is the open-source `rets` Ruby library it maintains for fetching data from RETS (Real Estate Transaction Standard) servers, distributed on RubyGems with a bundled command-line client. This profile was surfaced from VC-portfolio signals (500 Global, Uncork Capital) and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Mighty Buildings
providers.description: Mighty Buildings is a construction-technology and advanced-manufacturing company that industrializes homebuilding using large-format 3D printing, proprietary polymer-composite materials and robotic automation. Founded in 2019 and originally based in Oakland, California, it raised more than $150 million from investors including Khosla Ventures, Bold Capital and Aramco's Wa'ed Ventures, and was the first company certified under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies, as well as being certified under California's Factory Built Housing program. Its current product is the Mighty Kit System / Mighty Wall System - factory-made complete wall panels that arrive on site with integrated structure, insulation, waterproofing and exterior finish, so builders assemble a building envelope with conventional methods and fewer on-site steps. After a January 2025 restructuring and sale process, the full suite of Mighty Buildings technologies was acquired by LUMUS Inc., and Mighty Buildings now operates as a LUMUS brand headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon. The company sells physical building systems to developers and builders; it operates no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: RealPact
providers.description: RealPact is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-native operating system for real estate brokerages. Its voice-enabled AI agents automate the operational work behind every deal: the Deed Agent retrieves county deed records and flags encumbrances, the Tax & Vision Agent uses computer vision to extract tax assessments and property details, the Property Agent consolidates ownership and property information, and the Transaction Agent auto-fills contracts, manages disclosures, coordinates signatures, and tracks compliance deadlines. The company aims to compress transaction workflows from hours to minutes for brokerages, with early customers including Four Seasons Sotheby's International Realty and Black House Real Estate. Backed by Y Combinator and the LeapYear Fund, RealPact currently operates a customer-facing application and marketing site but publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program as of this profiling.

providers.name: Stanza Living
providers.description: Stanza Living is one of India's largest managed accommodation and co-living platforms, founded in 2017 by IIM-Ahmedabad alumni Anindya Dutta and Sandeep Dalmia and headquartered in Gurugram. It provides professionally managed, fully furnished, brokerage-free residences — student housing, co-living for working professionals, and managed apartments — across 24+ Indian cities, operating 450+ residences and more than 70,000 beds under the promise of "your second home in a new city." The company is backed by investors including Accel, Falcon Edge, Sequoia Capital and Matrix Partners. Stanza Living operates as a consumer web and mobile brand for discovering, booking and living in managed accommodation, and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Smart Crowd
providers.description: SmartCrowd is MENA's first and biggest regulated real estate crowdfunding and investment platform, based in Dubai and licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). It lets retail investors pool capital to co-own income-generating Dubai properties from as little as AED 500, offering both long-term Hold properties (rental yield) and short-term Flip properties (renovation upside), plus a secondary Share Transfer Facility for liquidity. SmartCrowd operates a consumer web and mobile app experience with no public developer API surface documented at this time.

providers.name: Swiftlane
providers.description: Swiftlane is a San Francisco-based physical security company providing cloud-based access control and video intercom systems for multifamily residential and commercial buildings. Its touchless, mobile-first platform combines face recognition, mobile and key-card credentials, visitor PIN access, vehicle readers, smart locks, and a centralized cloud management dashboard with access logs, user management, and remote unlock. Swiftlane publishes a customer product site, a large blog, and an Intercom-hosted help center, but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhooks; integrations are delivered through partners such as Okta, Azure, Google Workspace, and Eagle Eye.

providers.name: Willow Wealth
providers.description: Willow Wealth Inc. - formerly Yieldstreet - is a New York City financial technology company that operates an online private-markets investing platform, giving accredited and retail investors access to alternative asset classes including real estate, private credit, private equity, art, legal finance, and third-party evergreen funds from institutional managers. Founded in 2015 by Milind Mehere and Michael Weisz, the platform reports more than 500,000 members and over $6 billion in cumulative investments, and renamed itself Willow Wealth in late 2025. Investors reach it through a web portal and iOS/Android apps; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Behja
providers.description: Behja (Behja Holdings Limited Inc) is a licensed real estate platform in Saudi Arabia (License 120022677) that offers flexible rental-to-own housing. Its model lets residents select a property, apply, sign a three-year lease, and then buy with a full year's rent credited back toward the purchase. The integrated platform handles leases, purchases, and utility payments in one place. Behja is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Beike
providers.description: Beike (KE Holdings Inc.) is China's largest integrated online-and-offline platform for housing transactions and services, connecting home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents. It operates the Beike (贝壳) platform and the Lianjia (链家) brokerage brand, along with businesses spanning existing-home and new-home transactions, home rentals, and home renovation and furnishing. Its Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) lets brokerages and agents share listings and commissions across a standardized workflow. KE Holdings is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BEKE) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2423) and is headquartered in Beijing. This API Evangelist profile was created from venture-portfolio sourcing and enriched via the pipeline; Beike operates consumer-facing housing web and mobile properties and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: REEF
providers.description: REEF Technology operates a network of urban logistics and proximity real-estate locations, transforming underutilized spaces such as parking lots into multi-purpose neighborhood hubs for goods, services, and experiences. Through its "Power of Proximity" model and its Ulysses operator program, REEF connects brands, cloud/ghost kitchens, delivery, and mobility services to local consumers while helping property owners diversify revenue. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, REEF is a logistics and real-estate operator; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Scouter
providers.description: Scouter is a Mexican online marketplace, founded in 2021 in Guadalajara, for discovering and booking unique locations — houses, mansions, studios, terraces, haciendas, rooftops and more — for audiovisual productions, events, photo shoots and workshops across Mexico. It connects brands, agencies and production companies with the owners of over 1,500 spaces, handling quotes and reservations directly via WhatsApp (no public list prices, 8-hour minimum booking). Clients have included Netflix, HBO, Puma, Nike and Grupo Modelo. Backed by 500 Global (500 LatAm "Somos Lucha" Batch 16). The public product is a consumer/host web app at wearescouter.com; it exposes no public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched.

providers.name: 58.com
providers.description: 58.com (58同城, "58 Tongcheng") is China's largest online classifieds and local-services marketplace, often called the "Chinese Craigslist." Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing, it operates listings across recruitment and jobs, real estate and housing (Anjuke), used goods (Zhuanzhuan), automobiles, local services, and yellow-pages business directories. Formerly listed on the NYSE (WUBA), it was taken private in 2020 by a Warburg Pincus / General Atlantic consortium. Its 58 Open Platform (open.58.com) exposes payment, recruitment/jobs data, housing, local-service information, security risk-control, marketing, and social capabilities to approved third-party partners via reviewed developer accounts and API keys. Backed historically by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: 42 Floors
providers.description: 42Floors was a Y Combinator- and 500 Global-backed commercial real estate search platform founded in 2011 by Jason Freedman to make it easy to discover and lease office, coworking, retail, industrial, and warehouse space across top U.S. markets. It aggregated a large listings database (the "42Floors MLS") that brokers and tenants searched online. The company was acquired by Knotel in 2018, and the 42floors.com domain and listings service were later taken over by Yardi, which folded them into CommercialCafe — 42floors.com now redirects there. The only surviving developer surface is the first-party `mls` RubyGem, a client for the (now-decommissioned) 42Floors MLS API at mls.42floors.com.

providers.name: Stessa
providers.description: Stessa is a financial reporting, accounting, and management platform for rental property owners and small-to-mid-size landlords, headquartered in San Francisco and operated as a brand of Roofstock alongside Mynd and RentPrep. The platform helps owners track unlimited properties and portfolios with automated bank and credit card feeds, transaction categorization, mileage tracking, receipt scanning, Schedule E-ready tax reporting, online rent collection, tenant screening through RentPrep, e-signature leasing with 50+ legal templates, maintenance request tracking, and property-specific Stessa Cash Management accounts with high-yield APY and FDIC insurance up to $3M per entity. Stessa is delivered as a web app and iOS/Android mobile apps with three tiers — Essentials (free), Manage, and Pro — and serves more than 350,000 landlords. Bank, credit card, and payment data flows in through aggregator partners (Plaid-style open banking) rather than a public Stessa API, and the only developer-facing GitHub presence is an org with a handful of forked Ruby and Vue.js utilities.
